In this context, I relate the story of the wife of Vishnu : One day, he cooked the brinjals in her home and at the same time, Vishnu was called by the assembly of demons, where he went. At the same time, the great sage Narada reached the house of Vishnu and he was very hungry. Seeing the cooked vegetable of brinjals, his mind was tempted, but he did not get it even on asking for it. The wife of Vishnu said that she had prepared that food for her lord, therefore it was not possible for her to give it, “I have sent a messenger to call him and the may be coming.” The wife of Vishnu thought that if Narada partook it the food would become impure and her lord wound be angry with.
8 Part 1.75: Narada said : “The sage had been repeatedly asking for the food, but you did not give it to him.” The sage flew into rage and said : “You will live in the house of the demon Jalandhar as wife named Varinda, after getting her body.” No sooner than the sage departed after cursing her, Vishnu reached his home: Hearing about the curse, he was greatly agonised and his wife smilingly confirmed.
8 Part 1.76: Then Vishnu created Varinda from the shadow of his wife. She took birth on the earth in the house of the demon Dhumarkesh.
8 Part 1.77: Just as the lotus-leaf in water remains unaffected by the drops of water, in the same manner, Varinda lived in the house of Jalandhar as his wife. And for her Vishnu manifested himself as Jalandhar and in this way, Vishnu assumed a unique form. In this way, the story heath taken a new turn and now it hath halted on Rudra. The demon Jalandhar asked for his wife from Ruda and Rudra did not oblige him, therefore the king of demons flew into rage instantly. The trumpets and drums resounded on all the four sides and the knocking sound of tabors was heard from all the four directions. The steel collided with the steel dreadfully and the daggers glittered with infinite beauty. The warriors began to fall in the battlefield and the ghosts and fiends began to run on all the four sides. The innumerable riders of elephants, chariots and horses began to fall as martyrs in the battlefield.
8 Part 1.78: The warriors moved in the battlefield in great anger and a dreadful war began. Hearing the neighing of horses and the trumpeting of the elephants, the clouds of Sawan felt shy. The arrows and the swords were showered in the war and in this may this war was a dreadful and horrible war. The warriors fall, but in their persistence, they raise dreadful sound. In this way, the forces of the enemy, gathered quickly from all the four sides in the battlefield. Having been besieged from all the for sides, held his arrow and flew into rage over the demons. The arrows were showered so intensely from both the sides, that there was shade on the earth and over the sky. The helmets broke and fell in eh battlefield like the flowers saturated with blood. The unapproachable and unique Shiva thought over in this way in his mind. And perplexed in his heart, Shiva, shouting loudly, jumped into the forces of the demons. Holding his trident, he began to strike blows and hearing the sound of his blows, both the gods and demons were all filled with fear. When Shiva meditated in his mind on the non-temporal Lord, the Lord was pleased at the same time. Vishnu was ordered to manifest himself as Jalndhar and in this way destroy the king of enemies.
8 Part 1.79: The Destroyer Lord commanded and Vishnu manifested himself in the form of Jalandhar, and bedecked in all manner, he appeared as a kiing. Vishnu manifested himself in this form in order to protect his wife, and in this way, he defiled the chastity of the extremely chaste Varinda. Abandoning the body of demoness, Varinda again manifested herself as Lakshmi, the wife of Vishnu and in this way Vishnu assumed the twelfth incarnation in the form of a demon. The war continued again and the warriors held their weapons in their hands the brave fighters began to fall in the battlefield and also the air-vehicles came down in order to take away the dead warriors from the battlefield. On this side, the chastity of woman was defiled and on that side all the army was chopped. By this the pride of Jalandhar was shattered. But still weak king continued the fight and all his companions and subordinates ran away from the battlefield.
8 Part 1.80: Both Shiva and Jalandhar fought and there was none other in the battlefield. The war continued of several month and Jalndhar was filled with great fury for Shiva. Then Shiva meditated upon the Shakti and the Power was Gracious towards him. Now, Rudra getting mightier than before began to wage wr. On that side, Vishnu had defiled the chastity of woman, and on this side, Shiva also, having received the effulgence form the goddess, became more powerful. Therefore he destroyed the demon Jalandhar in and instant seeing this scene, all were pleased. Those who repeat the Name of Chandika, they know that from that day, Chnadika came to be known as Jalandhari. By repeating her name, the body becomes pure like taking bath in the Ganges. Keeping in mind the fear of making the book voluminous, I have not narrated the complete story of Rudra. This story has only been narrated in brief on knowing this, kindly do not jeer at me. End of the description of the twelfth i.e. JALANDHAR Incarnation.
8 Part 1.81: Now begins the description of the thirteenth i.e. VISHNU Incarnatiion: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji be helpful. CHAUPAI Now I enumerate the incarnations of Vishnu as to what type of incarnations he adopted. When the earth is distempered with the load of sins, then she manifested her anguish before the Destroyer Lord. When the demons cause the gods to run away and seize their kingdom from them, Then the earth, pressed under the load of sins, calls for help, and then the destroyer Lord becomes kind.
8 Part 1.82: Then taking the elements of all the gods and principally merging himself in it, Vishnu manifest himself in different forms and takes birth in the clan of Aditi.
8 Part 1.83: In this way, incarnating himself, he removes the load of the earth and destroys the demons in various ways. After removing the lord of the earth, he goes again to the abode of gods and merges himself in the Destroyer Lord. If I relate all these stories in detail, then it may delusively be called Vishnu-system. Therefore, I narrate it in brief and O Lord! protect me form ailment and suffering. End of the description of the thirteenth incarnation i.e.VISHNU .
8 Part 1.84: Now begins the description of the killing of Madhu and Kaitabh : Let Sri Bhagauti Ji be helpful. DOHRA In the body of the Immanent Lord, million of Vishnus and Shivas abide. Million of Indras, Brahmas, Suryas, Chandras and Varunas are present thre in His divine body.
8 Part 1.85: Fatigued by his work, Vishnu remains merged in Him and within that Immanent Lord, there are unaccountable oceans and worlds. The bed of Great serpent, on which that Immanent Lord sleeps, millions of Sheshanagas appear graceful near it. He hath thousands of heads, trunks and legs He hath thousands of hands and feet, He, the Invincible Lord He hath thousands of eyes and al types of excellences kiss his feet.
8 Part 1.86: The day on which Vishnu manifested himself for the killing of Madhu and Kaitabh, The poet Shyam knows him as fourteenth incarnation.
8 Part 1.87: From the dross of the ear, the demons were born and were considered glorious like Chandra and Surya. With the orders of the Immanent Lord, Vishnu abandoned maya and manifested himself at that time, when these demons indulged in riots. Vishnu waged ferocious war with them for five thousand years . The Immanent Lord then helped Vishnu and in great fury, he destroyed both the demons.
8 Part 1.88: In this way, Vishnu manifested himself as the fourteenth incarnation and in order to give comfort to the saints, he destroyed both these demons. End of the description of the fourteenth incarnation.
8 Part 1.89: Now begins the description of the incarnation named Arhant Dev : Let Sri Bhaguti Ji be helpful. CHAUPAI Whenever the demons extend their rule, then Vishnu comes to destroy them. Once all the demons gathered together the gods and their preceptors went to their abodes. All the demons gathered together and thought out, that Vishnu always destroys the demons And now they should devise some plan, to settle the issue. The preceptor of the demons said, “O demons, you have not understood this mystery till now “The gods gather together and perform Yajnas, therefore thay always remain happy. You should also perform sacrifices, and then you will be victorious in the battlefield. “You should then began the performance of a Yajna, and hearing about it , the people of the region of gods became fearful. All the gods went to meet Vishnu and said, “ O destroyer of demons take some steps now.” Vishnu said, “I shall manifest myself in a new body, and destroy the Yajna of the demons.” Vishnu then took bath at various pilgrim-stations, and distributed unlimited alms to the Brahmins. Brahma, born out of the heart-lotus of Vishnu, propagated the divine knowledge, and Vishnu mediated on the Immanent Lord. The Immanent Lord, then became Merciful and addressed his servant Vishnu with sweet words, “O Vishnu, manifest yourself in the forms of Arhant, and destroy the kings of the demons.” Vishnu, after receiving the orders of the Immanent Lord, eulogized him. He manifested himself as Arhant Dev on the earth and started a new religion. When he became the preceptor of the demons, he started different kinds of sects. One of the sects he started was Shravak sect and bestowed supreme comfort to the saints. He caused all to hold the forceps for plucking hair and in this way he made many demons devoid of the lock of hair on the crown of the head. Those without hair or without the lock of hair on the crown of their heads could not remember any mantra and if anyone repeated the mantra, there was negative influence of the mantra on him. Then he ended the performance of Yajnas and made all indifferent to the idea of violence on beings. There can be no Yajna without the violence on beings, therefore no one performed Yajna now. In this way, the practice of performing Yajnas was destroyed and anyone who used to kill beings, he was ridiculed. There could be no Yajna without the killing of beings and if one performed a Yajna, he availed no merit. The Arhant incarnation, instructed all in way, that no king could perform a Yajna. Everyone was put on a wrong path and no one was performing the action of Dharma.
8 Part 1.90: Just as corn is produced from corn, grass from grass In the same way the man from man.
8 Part 1.91: Such a knowledge was given to all that none performed the action of Dharma. Everyone’s mind was absorbed in such things and in this way, the clan of demons became weak. Such rules were propagated, that no demon could take a bath now, and without taking bath no one could become pure. Without becoming pure, no mantra could be recited and this way, all the actions became fruitless. In this way, Arhant ruled for ten thousand years and propagated his religion throughout the world. The actions of Dharma ended in the word and in this way, the clan of demons became weak. Indra, the king of gods, liked all this very much in his mind that Vishnu had done such a great thing for them. All of them forsaking grief, were filled with joy and the songs of happiness were sung in every home.
8 Part 1.92: Instructing in this way, Vishnu caused all to abandon the acions of Dharma and went back again to heavens. Assuming the status of supreme preceptor of Sharvakas and engrossing the demons on the wrong path, Vishnu manifested himself ad the fifteenth incarnation in this way. End of the description of ARHANT, the fifteenth incarnation in BACHITTAR NATAK.
8 Part 1.93: Now begins the description of the incarnation named King Manu: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji be helpful. CHAUPAI. All the people were absorbed in Shravak Religion and all abandoned the action of Dharma. All of them forsook the service of the Lord and none worshipped the Supreme preceptor. The saints became devoid of saintliness and all abandoned the action of Dharma Then the Immanent Lord ordered Vishnu, who did as commanded. Vishnu manifested himself as king Manu and propagated Manu Smriti in the world. He brought all the corrupt persons on the right path and cused the people to become devoid of sinful actions. Vishnu incarnated himself as the king Manu and established all the actions of Dgarma. If anyone committed a sin, he was now killed and in this way, the king made all his subjects to tread on the right path. The sinner was killed instantly and all the subjects were given instructions on Dharma. Now all attained the instructions about the Name of the Lord and about virtuous actions like charity etc. And in this way, the king got abandoned the discipline of Sharavaks. The people who had run away from the kingdom of the king Manu, they only remained adherents of Sharavak Religion. All the remaining subjects followed the path of Dharma and abandoning the wrong path, acquired the path of Dharma. The king Manu was the incarnation of Vishnu and he propagated in the right manner the actions of Dharma. He put all the followers of wrong values on the right path an brought the people towards Dharma, who were absorbed then in sinful action.
8 Part 1.94: All those who tread on the wrong paths, began to follow the right path and in this way, the Sharvak Religion receded far away. For this work, the king Manu was highly venerated in the whole world. For this work, the king Manu was MANU, the sixteenth incarnation in BACHITTAR BATAK.
8 Part 1.95: Now begins the description of the incarnation named Dhanantar Vaid: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji be helpful. CHAUPAI The people of all the world grew wealthy and there remained no anxiety on their body and mind. They began to eat various kinds of foods and consequentsly they suffered form various kinds of ailments. All the people got worried about their ailments and the subjects became extremely distressed. All of them snag the praises of the Immanent Lord and He become Gracious towards all. Vishnu was called by the Supreme Lord and ordered to manifest himself in the form of Dhanwantar. He also told him to spread Ayurveda and destroy the ailments of the subjects.
8 Part 1.96: Then all the gods gathered and churned the ocean, And for the welfare of the subjects and destruction of their ailments, they acquired Dhanantar from the ocean.
8 Part 1.97: He spread Ayurveda and destroyed the ailments from the whole world. He disclosed the Vaidic Shastra and brought it before the people and described various medicines.
8 Part 1.98: Administering the medicines to all the world, he made the world devoid of ailments, And departed for heaven after having been stung by Takshak. End of the description of the seventeenth incarnation named DHANANTAR in BACHITTAR NATAK.
8 Part 1.99: Now begins the description of the Suraj Incarnation: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji be helpful. CHAUPAI The might of demos, the sons of Diti, increased very much and they conquered many enemies in water and on land. Receiving the command of the Immanent Lord, Vishnu manifested himself as Suraj incarnation. Wherever the demons become Lord, Vishnu manifested himself as Suraj incarnation kills them in different ways. The sun destroyed the darkness from the earth and in order to give comfort to the subjects, he used to roam hither and thither.
8 Part 1.100: all the people abandoned idleness and woke up at dawn and meditating on the Omnipresent Lord, used to repeat His Name in various ways. Working on difficult jobs, they used to stablise in their mind the Uninstallable Lord and used to recite the Gyatri and Sandhya. All the people, repeating the name of the Lord, used to perform godly deeds and also reflected on the Vedas and Vyakarna etc. alongwith the burning of incense, lighting the earthen lamps and performing Yajnas. They used to perform rituals for the manes according to their power and used to concentrate on virtuous actions alongwith the recitation of Shastras, Smritis etc.

8 Part 2.1: The smoke of Yajnas was visible on all the four sides and all the people slept on the earth. Performing mediation and worship in many ways, they used to work for the growth of distant places. Reciting many mantras, the people performed Yogic discipline and repeated the Name. They meditated on the Detached Supreme Purusha and ultimately they acquired the air-vehicles for transportation to heaven.
8 Part 2.2: In this way a good deal of time elapsed in performing religious and charitable actions and then a powerful demon named deeraghkaya was born.
8 Part 2.3: His body increased in length everyday by the length of an arrow and he destroyed the gods and twice-born night and day. On the birth of the enemy like deeraghkaya, even the chariot of the sun hesitated to move.
8 Part 2.4: ARIL When the chariot of the sun stopped moving, the sun, then in great fury, marched forward alongwith his arms, weapons and forces. He started various types of war seeing which both gods and demons, experienced a dilemma. Holding their swords in their hands, the warriors of both the side, fought with one another in the battlefield. They fell, having been chopped into bits, but still they did not retrace their steps. Having been wounded, their increased still further and they appeared like the members of the marriage party walking and exhibiting their dressers.
8 Part 2.5: Hearing the resounding of the trumpets, the clouds are feeling shy. The army is swelling forward like the clouds, from all the four side, and it appears that there is a large gathering of peacocks in the forest.
8 Part 2.6: The luster of the shields appears like the red roses. The movement of warriors and the shooting of arrows are creating different distinct sounded. Such a sound is being heard in the battlefield as if the clouds are thundering. The resounding of the drums and the sound of the empty quivers is also being hard. The warriors are battled and seeing the dreadful war, they are mediating upon the Lord-God. All are absorbed in the war and are submerged in the thoughts of war. The brave fighters are moving hither and thither and the heavenly damsels are looking at them. The heroes have abandoned everything and having been chopped several warriors have played with their lives. The arrows are glittering and the flags are flying The warriors are fighting face to face very quickly and the blood is oozing out of their chests. Bedecked with the arrows, the brave warriors are roaring They are ornamented with steel armours and are moving towards heaven. When the superior arrows are discharged, the chests of the enemies are wounded. The shields being cut are producing knocking sound and the armours are being torn.
8 Part 2.7: Taking his arrow in his hand, Suraj ran towards the enemy Deeraghkaya and in great ire began a dreadful war. Many people came running under the refuge of gods, and Suraj, who ends the night, conquered many warriors. The warriors are striking the daggers, holding them tightly and coming face to face and the brave fighters are challenging one another, roaring like the lions. The firm limbs, after swinging continuously, are falling down and the brave and beautiful fighters, fearlessly coming face to face with others are clashing.

8 Part 2.18: Speech of Shravan : There were still some life-breath in the body of Shravan. In his final life-breaths, the Brahmin said to the kind: “My mother and father are blind and are lying on that side. You go there and make them drink water, so that I may die peacefully.”

When the king reached near them with very slow steps, then they heard the voice of the moving footsteps.

8 Part 2.35: Speech of the Poet: Hearing these words of the enemy, Ram looked like a mighty hero. Visualising the serene posture of Ram, exhibiting the serenity of seven seas, the mountains, Sky and the whole world trembled. The Yakshas, Nagas, gods gods demons of all the four directions were frightened. Getting hold of his bow in his hand, Ram said to Parashuram, “On whom you have stretched this arrow in anger?”
8 Part 2.36: Speech of Parashuram addressed to Ram : “O Ram! whatever you have said, you have said and now if you say anything further, then you will not remain alive “The weapon that you had to wield, you have wielded and if you try to wield anything more, your effort will be of no avail.” Then getting furious Parashuram said to Ram, “Say, where will you run away now from war and how will you save your life? “O Ram! breaking the bow of Shiva and now wedding Sita you will not be able to reach your home.”
8 Part 2.37: Speech of Ram addressed to Parashuram: SWAYYA “O Brahmin! you have already said whatever you wanted to say and if you say anything more now, you will have to risk your life. “O fool! why do you speak with such pride, you will have to go now to your home after getting your teeth broken and after receiving good tharashin. “I am seeing you with patience if I consider it necessary, then I shall have to discharge only one arrow. “Therefore talk with restraint, otherwise you will receive the reward for such talk just now.”
8 Part 2.38: Speech of Parashuram : SWAYYA “You should then deem it true that if you are called Ramvtar, “Then the way you have broken the bow of Shiva, show me your strength in the same way “Show me your mace, discus, bow and also the mark of the stroke of the foot of sage Bhrigu. “Alongwith this dismount my mighty bow and pull its string.”
8 Part 2.39: Speech of the Poet : SWAYYA Ram, the supreme hero took the bow in his hand smilingly Pulled its string and tightening the arrow, broke it into two pieces. On breaking, the bow produced such a dreadful sound as if the arrow had struck the chest of the sky which gad burst. The manner in which the dancer jumps on the rope, in the same way the whole universe shook on the breaking of the bow and remained entangled within the two pieces of the bow. End of the description of Ram’s victory in war.
8 Part 2.40: Now begins the description of the Entry in Oudh : SWAYYA With tears of joy in both his eyes and meeting affectionately with his people Ram entered Ayodhya. The black bees were humming on the cheeks and the braids of long hair of Sita were hanging like the Nagas looking towards her face. The lotus, deer, moon, lioness and nightingale were perplexed in their minds and seeing her. The children, seeing her beauty, also were falling unconscious and the travelers abandoning their path, were looking at her. Sita was getting worried on reflecting whether Ram will agree with her sayings or not And also whether it can happen that Ram may wed another woman like wedding me on breaking the bow of Shiva. If he thinks another marriage in his mind, then her Lord on forgetting her, will fill her life definitely with unrest. Let us see that is recorded in my fate and what he will do in future? At that same time, the groups of Brahmins came forward and began and thither in joy. Hearing about the victory of Ram in the war, all the people ran hither and thither in joy. When Dasrath came to know that after conquering Sita, Ram has also conquered the war, Then his delight knew no bounds and he showered the wealth like the rain of clouds. The doors of all the subjects were bedecked with greetings and the sandalwood was sprinkled over all the houses. Saffron was sprinkled over all the companions and it seemed that Indra was entering his city. The drums and other musical instruments resounded and the dances of various kinds were arranged. All the people advanced to meet Ram and the father Dasrath took his son with him and reached Oudhpuri.
8 Part 2.41: With great enthusiasm the marriage of the three remaining sons was fixed. After the marriage of Ram and Sita, the congratulatory messages were received from various countries, when they returned to their home. There was atmosphere of zest on all sides and the arrangements were being made for the celebration of the marriage of three sons. On all sides the drums resounded in various tunes and many companies of dancers began to dance. The warriors decorated with armours and the youthful soldiers marched forward. All these great charioteers and archers came and stood at the gate of the king Dasrath. Many types of musical instruments resounded and the melodious sounds of the drums were heard. The energetic women began to sing and reveal their joy by dancing their eyes and clapping their hands. The beggars had no more desire for wealth because the gift of gold flowed like a stream. Anyone who asked for one thing, he would return to his home with twenty things. The sons of king Dasrath playing in the forests appeared like the flowers bloomed in spring season. The saffron sprinkled on the limbs appeared like the bliss gushing forth form the heart. They are gathering their limitless fourfold army like the gushing forth of the Ganges. With their armed forces the princes appear glorious like millions of suns in the sky. All the brothers blongwith Bharat seem in such splendour which cannot be described. The beautiful princes are alluring the minds of their mothers and appear like the sun and moon born in the house of Diti, increasing its magnificence. In this way the beautiful wedding parties were emblished. Which are indescribable By saying all this the volume of the book will be increased And all these children moved towards the place of their father for getting his permission to depart. They ll came and bowed before their father and stood there with folded hands. The king was filled with joy on seeing his sons and he gave many things in charity to the Brahmins. Hugging their children to their bosom the parents felt great pleasure like a poor man on acquiring the gems. After taking permission for departure they reached the place of Ram and bowed their on his feet.
8 Part 2.42: Ram kissed the heads of all and placed his hand on their back with love, He presented with betel leaf etc. and affectionately bade them farewell. Playing on the drums and the musical instruments all the people moved as if millions of suns and moons have manifested on the earth. The garments saturated with saffron are looking splendid as if the beauty itself has materialized. The princes of Dasrath the king of Oudh, appear splendid like the god of love alongwith his arts.
8 Part 2.43: All have moved out of Oudhpuri and all of them taken along with them the winsome warriors, who never retrace their steps in war. They are beautiful princes, bedecked with necklaces around their necks. They are all going to bring their wedded women. They are all the mashers of the tyrants, capable of conquering the three worlds, lovers of the name of the Lord and brothers of Ram. They are magnanimous in wisdom, the incarnation of embellishment, the mountain of munificence and are just like Ram.
8 Part 2.44: The description of horses : KABIT The horses, restless like the eyes of a women, swift like the swift utterances of a shrewd person an mercurial like the crane rising up in the sky, are vibrating hither and thither. They are swift like the feet of a dancer, they are the tactics of throwing the dice or even some hallucination. These brave horses are swift like arrow and gunshot, shrewd and mighty like Hanuman, the son of Anjani they are roaming like the fluttering banners. These horses are like the intense emotions of the god of love, or the swift waves of the Ganges. They have beautiful limbs like the limbs of cupid and are not stable at any one place. All the princes are being considered as moon by the night and sun by the day, they are known as great donors for the beggars, the ailments consider them as medicine. When they, consisting of endless beauty are nearby, them there is suspicion about their impending separation. They are all most honourable like Shiva. They are famous swordsmen, childlike for their mothers, the supreme knowledgeable for great sages, they appear apparently like probvidence. Having bathed in ambrosia and the manifestation of beauty and glory, these very winsome princes appear as having been created in special mould. It seems that in order to allure some most beautiful damsel the providence created these great heroes in a special way. They appear as having been taken out as gems by churning the ocean by the gods and demons on abandoning their disputes. Or it seems that the Lord of the universe made improvement in the creation of their faces himself for having their continuous sight. Crossing the frontier of their kingdom and passing through other countries, all these princes reached the abode of king Janak of Mithila. On reaching there they caused the high-pitch resonance of the drums and other musical instruments. The king came forward and hugged the all three to his bosom, all the Vedic rites were performed. There was continuous chartable flow of wealth and on acquiring the alsm, the beggars became king-like. The banners were unfurled and the drums resounded, the brave heroes began to shout loudly on reaching Janakpuri. Somewhere the whisks are being swung, somewhere the minstrels are singing eulogies and somewhere the poets are reciting their beautiful stanza. Somewhere the lyre is being played, somewhere flutes, drum and other musical instruments. On seeing all this the god of love is feeling shy and so mush charity was donated that the beggars feel satisfied. The poor became king-like and began to give blessings after receiving alms, no tendency for begging was left. Janak came and hugged all the three to his bosom and honoured them in various ways. The Vedic discipline was observed and the Brahmins recited the congratulatory Vedic mantras. The king gave the gift of gold to each Brahmin, the princes were given presents and there was shower of gems. The white elephants and the brisk horses of Sindhu were presented to the princes, in this way all the three princes moved black after their wedding.
8 Part 2.45: After marrying the daughter of King Janak, the princes soon asked for permission to depart. This group of kings accompanied by elephants and horses, having many desires in their mind, started. The sacrificial pit was dug up there and a pillar of righteousness was established. A horse was let off from the stable so that ending the glory of other king they may be conquered. The kings several countries were sent alongwith the horse and all of them were persons of beauteous limbs and the enhancer of glory.
8 Part 2.46: The king Dasrath made selection of other efficient kings and sent them with the horse. They went having been completely embellished. These brave men were of very gentle demeanour. They roamed in several countries, both inland and foreign and at all the places they destroyed all with the blaze of their glory. They caused their horse to revolve on all the four sides and in this way they enhanced the royal prestige of king Dasrath. Many kings bowed at his feet and he removed all their agonies. He completed his Yajna and in this way destroyed the anguish of his subjects. Receiving the gifts of many kinds the Brahmins pleased and satisfied in their mind they moved back to their places. Giving the blessing of various kinds and singing the Vedic mantras. The kings of the inland and foreign countries decorate themselves in various garbs, And noticing the significant glory of the warriors, the beautiful and cultured women were allured towards them. Millions of musical instruments were played and all the bedecked persons were full of love. The idols of gods were established and all were bowing with respect to the gods, expressing their gratitude. All the people prostrated and bowed at the feet of gods and were assuming significant emotions in their minds. Therefore was recitation of mantras and yantras and the idols of Ganas were being fixed. Beautiful women and heavenly damsels began to dance. In this way there was the sway of Ram Rajya and there was no dearth of anything.
8 Part 2.47: On one side the Brahmins are teaching about the activities of various countries, And on the other side the methods of archery are being reveled. Instructions are being given about various types of the embellishments of women. The art of love, poetry, grammar and Vedic learning are being taught side by side. The incarnation of Ram of the clan of Raghu is extremely pure. He is the destroyer of tyrants and demons and is thus the support of the life-breath of the saints. He has subordinate the king of various countries by conquering them, And his banners of victory are fluttering here, there and everywhere. The king gave his three sons the kingdoms of three directions and gave Ram the kingdom of his capital Ayodhya, After discussing for a long time with Vasishtha, There lived a demoness in the house of Dasrath in disguise, Who had asked for all this activity the fructifying mango dust, pure water of the stream and many flowers. Four adorned slavers containing saffron, sandalwood etc., Were kept with the king for the fulfillment of this function. At the same time Brahma sent a Gandharva woman named Manthra to the place, Who embellished with all kinds of arts and wearing white garments started very quickly. She was surprised to listen to the sound of lyre, drum and other musical instruments, And also saw on that wide plain the sound hailing the victory of ram Rajya was being heard. Going near Kaikeyi she addressed her in this way : “When the opportunity will go out of hand, then for whom you will ask for the boons?” When Kaikeye heard all the account, she was completely full of anguish, And fell down unconscious on the earth like the doe pierced by an arrow. Going in the presence of king of Oudh, she said this : “O king! You had promised to grant me two boons, grant them to me just now. “Give exile to Ram and your kingdom, wealth, whisk an canopy-everything. Give him the kingdom, wealth, whisk and canopy-everything “When you will grant me the ruling power over the inland and foreign countries, “Then I shall consider you the observer of truthfulness and recognizer of righteousness.” The king replied, “O sinful woman! What approbation you will gain by sending Ram to the forest? “By such surpassing utterance of yours the ash of magnificence on my forehead has flown down with the upcoming perspiration.” The king taking his bow in his hand said this angrily, “I would have chopped and thrown you just now, “And destroyed you, but I let you go because you are a woman.”
8 Part 2.48: “The superb god amongst men is Ram who is certainly the abode of Dhrma, “O foolish woman! why are you uttering such contrary words? “He is unfathomable and infinite god and is highly seated beyond all elements. “He is merciful and kind towards all and mercifully gives support to helpless and ferries them across. “He is the saviour of many saints and is the basic cause of the gods and demons. “He is also the king of gods and is the store of all powers.” The queen said, “O king! Grant me the boons and fulfil thy sayins. “Adandon the position of duality from your mind and do not fail in your promise.”
8 Part 2.49: “O king! Do not hesitate and run away from your promise, give exile to Ram. “Bid farewell to Ram and take back the proposed rule from him. Don’t run away from your promise and be seated peacefully. “O king! Cal Vasishtha and the royal priest and send Ram to the forest.” The king heaved a long sigh, moved hither and thither and then fell down. The king again came to his senses from the stupor and grievously heaved a long breath.
8 Part 2.50: With tears in his eyes and anguish in his utterance, The kin said to Kaikeyi, “You are a mean and evil woman. “You are a blemish on womankind and a store of vices. “You have no shame in your eyes and your words are ignominious. “You are evil woman and are the destroyer of enhancement. “You are performer of evil deeds and shameless in your Dharma. “You are the abode of shamelessness and a woman forsaking hesitation. “You are the performer of misdeeds and destroyer of glory. “O shameless woman! you are the doer of evil acts, “Impiety-incarnate and store of vicious works. “O the basket of sins! evil-doer, “You do not die even we wish you to die, you are the performer of misdeeds.”
8 Part 2.51: The Speech of Kaikeyi: “O king! Accept my saying and remember your words “Whatever you have promised, grant me two boons according to that. “Remember rightly and give whatever you have said. “Do not forsake your Dharma and do not shatter my trust. “Call Vasishtha, your unique spiritual head, “Order the husband of Sita for his exile. “Do not cuase any delay in the task and accept my saying “Making Ram a sage, turn him out of the home ” She was stubborn like a child and verged on madness. She did not keep silent and was continuously speaking. She was worthy of reproach and store of man acts. She was evil-tongued queen and the cause of weakening the strength of the king. She got the ouster of Ram, who was the pillar of the house And in this way she performed the evil act of killing her husband.
