When the Brahmin mediated on KAL, then he appeared before him and said, “Do not worry in your mind, I shall kill many enemies for your sake.” Then a dreadful sound was heard from the basement of the temple and Kalki incarnation manifested Himself, he was long like the palm tree, He had bedecked His waist with quiver and he was riding on a beautiful horse.
8 Part 15.37: There was a loud sound and the heroic spirits began to dance tying small bells round the ankles The maces, tridents, quivers and lances swung and waved like the dark clouds of Sawan. The army had worn beautiful garments and that three hundred hands long-sized Kalki drew out his double-edged sword The horses sprung like leopards and began to rotate. The trumpets were sounded and the armies confronted each other, the warriors advanced through the armies They sprang and revolved and the swords struck with jerks.
8 Part 15.38: Seeing him, all ran away, everyone coveted to see him. Seeing his powerful form, the sun is feeling shy and his effulgence is mocking the powerful light. The persistent warriors in rage are inflamed like the furnace, the powerful group of warriors is even scoffing at the sun. The soldiers of the king advanced in rage and they were holding their arms and weapons in their hands.
8 Part 15.39: Imbued with the idea of fighting, getting enraged, the warriors riding the horses are swinging their arms and weapons. In their fury, they are grinding their teeth and talking in themselves and filled with ego these warriors are discharging their arrows. Kalki, getting infuriated caught hold of His axe in his long arms and with its slightest blow, four hundred warriors died and fell down.
8 Part 15.40: The drums sounded, the horses swung and the warriors thundered. The thundering warriors discharged arrows, their shields were raised and the rhythmic sound was heard. The daggers glistened, the flaming fires blazed and the flames rose high. The blood oozed out from the wounds, which demonstrated the zeal of the warriors, they ran and fell in the multitude. The helmets broke, the drums sounded and the heavenly damsels danced in consonance with the tune. The limbs were chopped, they fell down and because of the discharged arrows, the warriors were tossed about violently. The warriors fought bravely and the cowards ran away, the heroic fighters were filled with anger and malice. With the discharge of the arrows, the cowards ran away and the zeal was exhibited by the oozing wounds. The limbs and corpses of the warriors engaged in war fell up and down. The shields gleamed and seeing the chopped heads, Shiva began to dance and wear the rosaries of skulls. The horses sprang and the warriors seeing the corpses and chopped heads got pleased. The swords saturated with hot blood glistened and Shiva danced and laughed. The warriors, getting together, began to discharge arrows and taking their gleaming shields they began to wed the heavenly damsels. The intoxicated sound is rising from all the four sides and the chopped limbs are falling down in the battlefield. The warriors are fighting with each other with great zeal and the musical instruments are being and played in the battlefield. The tips of the arms and weapons are entering the bodies and the Kshatriyas are striking their arms and weapons in the battlefield. The warriors falling on the earth and then swinging up and fighting are shouting for water. The directions have disappeared by the discharge of arrows, the warriors are falling and the cowards are running away. Shiva while dancing and playing his tabor is roaming and wearing the rosaries of skulls. The heavenly damsels are dancing and with the dreadful fighting by warriors and running away by the cowards, there is a break in the tune. The warriors fall on being struck by the arrows and the headless trunks of the warriors are being chopped through the middle. The blood-spilling warriors are fighting with double zeal and with the blows of the arms, the canopies of the warriors being cut down, are falling. The tips of the striking arms are piercing the bodies, the horses are neighing and the warriors are thundering. The shields and the armours are being cut, the warriors are falling on the earth and getting up while swinging. The hands have fought with hands, the young soldiers being chopped and the arrows, flying numerously are being planted in the bodies.
8 Part 15.41: Seeing the unique beauty, the warriors are getting infuriated and wearing their weapons are reaching in the war-arena The warriors are inflicting wounds from both the sides and are hoping to get the declaration of victory, with the breakage of weapons, their bright tips are being seen. The warriors rotating while roaming, are raising dreadful sounds, seeing the glory of the warriors, the cowards are running away Shiva is engaged in Tandava dance and the daggers are colliding with one another producing various types of sounds. The sons of the demons, getting, frightened are running away and the sharp arrows are being discharged on them The Yoginis are dancing in the fourteen directions and the Sumeru mountain are trembling. All the warriors of Shiva are dancing and the heavenly damsels, after recognizing the fierce fighters are wedding them The witches in their fury are shouting and the yaskshas, gandharvas, imps, ghosts, fiends etc. are laughing. The vultures flying and revolving, are devouring flesh and the vampires are drinking blood, filling it in their bowls The female ghosts and fiends are laughing while drinking blood and the luster of the swords is being seen and the continued laughter is being heard in the battlefield.
8 Part 15.42: The warriors fought, the arrows were discharged, the horses died and the fighters fell down. The soldiers discharging their arrows and being absorbed in the war are fighting with various limbs. The swords are broken, the limbs are heavenly damsels are roaming for wedding them. The elephants are engaged in fighting with other elephants, the camels, very high, are absorbed in fighting with other powerful camels. With the discharge of arrows, the warriors being chopped are falling on the ground, they are getting up again. They are shouting “kill, kill” in all the four directions and bedecking themselves, they are striking their weapons.
8 Part 15.43: There are seen many warriors able to confront the very great power and there are also seen those in helpless condition. The warriors are challenging and are consciously striking blows. The warriors of Shiraz sat down after feeling shy. Kalki inspires them to get up and cause them to see, he revolves the sword and strikes its edge.
8 Part 15.44: Where the warriors are fighting and the arrows are being discharged, there the warriors get up and their armours, being shattered are falling down. The warriors falling down in the war-arena are ferrying across the ocean of fear and the heavenly damsels roaming in the sky, are wedding the warriors. Listening to the musical instruments of the battlefield, the cowards are running away and abandoning the battlefield, they are feeling shy. The warriors are again rotating and embracing death by fighting, they do not retrace even one step from the battlefield and are ferrying across the dreadful ocean of Samsara by dying. In the dreadful war, the fourfold army was scattered into fragments and because of the infliction of wounds on the bodies of the warriors, their honour and respect declined. Without retracing their steps even slightly, the warriors are fighting and in anger, they are besieging the army. They fall down on the earth after dying and the women of gods are wedding them, the warriors getting enraged in their mind, do not retrace even one step. Getting infuriated, the warriors do not run for two steps and fighting in anger, they fall on the ground. Because of the sound of the musical instruments of the battlefield the clouds are feeling shy and the bedecked warriors are not retracing, even slightly. The striking discs are shattering the glory and pride of the warriors, because of the dreadfulness of war, the Sumeru mountain has also trembled and the steam of the blood of the warriors is flowing. The dreadful war is going on with terrible explosions and the horse-riders are fixing their columns of victory. Holding their swords in fury, the warriors are fighting and fighting with the strength of their mind, they are not moving back.
8 Part 15.45: The warriors are challenging and shouting, they are striking blows with their swords. The warriors are raising their weapons and exhibitir them, they are revolving and striking them. They are aiming at the target in fury and carrying the weapons, they are giving the relish of their edges the enemies. There are thousands of staunch warriors. The shouting and crying warriors have gathered, they are excited and being chopped they are falling and bowing down. The soldiers are hesitatingly aiming their arrows on their targets. The echoes are being heard and the arrows are being shot. The embellished warriors are thundering and are not running away. Taking up their bows, arrows and quivers, the charming warriors are fighting. With the winking of their eyelids, the warriors are getting angry and giving jolts to one another while laughing. The charming warriors are discharging their arrows patiently. The warriors are fighting in retaliation and are grappling one another. The warriors are challenging without getting tired, and they are penetrating forward. The unchoppable warriors are being killed. The warriors striking blows, are bowing, challenging and getting up again.
8 Part 15.46: The arrows are being discharged, the warriors are fighting, the limbs are being split and the war is continuing. The warriors are getting excited, the heavenly damsels are roaming and the sparks of fire coming out of the colliding swords. The limbs are being splitted, all are absorbed in the war, the horses are dancing and the warriors are thundering. The blows are being endured with pleasure, the warriors are falling down while swinging and thundering. Contacting the numberless spirits, the warriors are lamenting, they are getting unconscious and falling down, the ghosts are dancing. The warriors are fighting catching hold of arrows, the beauty is resplendent on all the faces and the heavenly damsels are looking at the warriors. The warriors are fighting with the elephants after killing the enemies, they are running away after being hit by the arrows. The warriors are lying down unconscious and in their fury, their hair have been loosened and their attires have been damaged. The worriers have been destroyed while fighting with the elephants, the horses are roaming openly and the worriers are thundering. The heavenly damsels are roaming over the whole earth, on being hit by the arrows the warriors are embracing martyrdom. With the discharge of the arrows the directions have been hidden from view and the swords are gleaming high up in the sky. The ghosts, arising from the graves, are coming towards the battlefield, the warriors are thundering and the horses are running. The warriors whose limbs have been chopped, are falling in the war arena and the intoxicated warriors are being killed. The cries of “kill, kill” are being heard in all the four directions, the warriors are closing in and are not backing out. They are striking blows with their lances, while shouting, the whiskers of those egoists are also charming. The drums are being played and the warriors are shouting, the trumpets are sounding and the persistent warriors are fighting with one another. The warriors are thundering, the horses are jumping, the arrows are being discharged and the fighters are going astray in the multitude.
8 Part 15.47: Where the warriors are fighting in the battlefield, there is much pomp and show, when the lances are turned upside down, there appears a miracle. Where the steel is colliding, there the warriors are thundering, the armours are colliding with the armours, but the warriors are not retracing even two steps. Somewhere the horses are running, somewhere the warriors are thundering, somewhere the heroic fighters are fighting and somewhere the warriors with breaking of their helmets are falling down. Where the warriors have gathered, there they are striking the blows of their arms, they are fearlessly chopping with their weapons and killing the fighters. Somewhere there are cries of “kill, kill”, and somewhere the horses are springing, somewhere seeing the opportunity the army is being removed. Somewhere the wounds are being inflicted and somewhere the army is being pushed, somewhere the bodies saturated with blood are falling on the earth.
8 Part 15.48: In this way, the dreadful war continued for a short while and two lakhs and one thousand warriors died in this war.
8 Part 15.49: When the king of Sambhal heard this, he, getting mad with anger turned black like the dark cloud, during the night, with his magic power, he, magnified his body to such an extent that head touched the sky. With helmets on his head, he seems like the suns among the clouds, his powerful body is like Shiva, the Lord of Chandra, which is indescribable. It seemed that the flames were rising and the king had worn the weapons like the Guru Dronacharya. The warriors shouting “kill, kill” were coming near and with the blows of their arms and weapons, the wounds were being inflicted. With the sound of the collision of the dagger with dagger, the fishes of water were getting agitated and on all the four sides, the arrows were being showered violently. Wearing beautiful garments, the warriors are falling down and on all the four sides, the warriors of charming whickers, were absorbed in lamenting. The arrows and swords of sharp edges are being struck and the warriors are moving inspite of the chopping of their limbs. The flesh-eating beings are dancing and vultures and crows in the sky are getting pleased, the rosaries of skulls are being strung for the neck of Shiva and it seems that all have got intoxicated on drinking wine. The warriors being chopped by chopped by the edges of the weapons and the blows of the arms, spilling their blood are getting unconscious and falling down. The warriors, flowing in the current of anger, are striking dreadfully their weapons and with the collision of the bloody daggers they are being excited doubly. The goddess, thirsty of blood, is laughing and her laughter is pervading on all the four sides like the illumination of her light. The determined warriors are fighting taking up their shields and Shiva wearing his rosary of skulls is dancing, the blows of weapons and arms are being struck. The patient warriors are discharging arrows by repeatedly pulling their bows and the swords are being struck like the flash of lightning. The bloody daggers are colliding and with double excitement, the warriors are fighting, those elegant warriors are shouting “kill, kill”. Pressing one another, the warriors are looking magnificent and the great warriors are inflicting wounds on one another. The warriors are engaged like wrestlers among themselves and striking their weapons they are desiring for their victory. The warriors are imbued with war and with double excitement, they are striking their bloody dagger. The heavenly damsels are moving the sky and the warriors, greatly tired, are falling down, the sound of clapping is being heard and Shiva is dancing. The sound of lamentation is rising in the battlefield and alongwith it, there is also shower of arrows, the warriors are thundering and the horses are running from this side to that side.
8 Part 15.50: In this way, a dreadful war was waged and the ghosts, fiends and Baitals began to dance, the lances and arrows spread in the sky, and it appeared that the night had fallen during the day. Somewhere the imps and fiends are dancing in the battlefield and somewhere after continued fighting the warriors have fallen in the war-arena, somewhere the Bhairavas are shouting loudly and somewhere the dreadful crows are flying. The small and big drums, trumpets, flute etc., are all being played, the pipe and fife are also being played and the warriors, getting frightened, are running away. Great warriors fell martyrs in that battlefield and there was commotion in the country of Indra, the lances and arrows spread in the world like the rushing forth of the clouds of Sawan.
8 Part 15.51: Getting infuriated in many ways the warriors are discharging arrows by pulling their bows, whosoever is hit by these arrows, he leaves for heaven. There are heaps of chopped limbs lying somewhere and somewhere there are lying arrows and swords, somewhere there are seen garments, somewhere lances and somewhere armours of steel. The warriors are dyed in the colour of war like the kinsuk flowers, some of them are dying while fighting as if they are playing Holi. Someone is coming running and is not retracing even two steps backwards, they are striking blows like playing Holi.
8 Part 15.52: Now Kalki will get enraged and will knock down and kill a gathering of warriors, he will strike blows with various types of weapons and will destroy the groups of enemies. The arrows contacting the armours will be discharged and in this war, the gods and demons will all confront one another, there will be showers of lances and arrows and the warriors will strike shouting “kill, kill” from their months. He will take out his axe and sword and in his fury, he will strike the gods and demons, he will cause the corpses fall over corpses in the war-arena and seeing this, the fiends and fairies will get pleased. The ganas of Shiva will roar and seeing them in affliction, all the people will run away, they will move in the war-arena discharging the arrows continuously. The swords will collide with one another and seeing all this, the great warriors will thunder, the generals will march forward from both the sides and shout “kill, kill” from their mouths. Ganas, Gandharvas and gods will see all this and will raise the sounds of “hail, hail”, the axes and swords will be struck and the limbs, being cut into halves, will fall, The intoxicated horses imbued with war, will neigh and the sound of anklets and small cymbals will be heard, the generals of both the sides will fall upon each other and will glisten their swords, while holding them in their hands. The groups of elephants will roar in the war-arena and seeing them, the clouds will feel shy, all will fight in anger and the canopies of chariots etc. will drop from the hands of the warriors very quickly. The war-trumpets sounded in all the directions and the warriors raising shouts turned towards the war-arena, now in their fury, they will strike blows with their swords and will quickly inflict wounds on the warriors. Taking out his sword in his hand and glistening it, Kalki will increase his approbation in the Iron Age, he will scatter the corpse upon corpse and aiming the warriors as targets, he will kill them. The thick clouds will rush forth in the war-arena and in the winking of the eye, the arrows will be discharged, he will hold his swords and strike it with a jerk and the crackling noise of the arrows will be heard. The elephants, horses, chariots and chariot-riders will be chopped and the warriors catching each other by their hair, they ill swing, there will be blows of legs and fists and the heads will be shattered with teeth. The kings of the earth will re-array their armies and hold their bows and arrows, there will be fought a dreadful war in anger in both the directions and the warriors will obtain a place in heaven in the dreadful war. The swords will clatter and the jingling of the steel armours will be heard, the sharp-edged weapons will produce knocking sounds and the Holi of the war will be played. The lances will be struck from both sides and the matted locks of the warriors will roll in dust, the spears will collide while striking blows like the thundering of the clouds of Sawan. The warriors grinding their teeth in anger will cause their horses to dance from both sides, they will discharged arrows from their bows in the war-arena and will cut the saddles of horses and the armours. The warriors will rush forth like clouds and will roam in all the ten directions, shouting,”kill, kill”, with their utterance of “kill, kill”, the heart of Sumeru mountain will all move. Crores of elephants and horses and also the riders of elephants will die fighting. To what extent the poet will describe them? The ganas, gods and demons will all see and hail. Lakhs of lances and arrows will be discharged and the banners of all colours will wave in the war-arena, the superb warriors will fall on the enemies taking their shields etc. and in all the ten directions the sound of “kill, kill” will be heard. The armours etc. will be seen flying in the war and the warriors will pitch their column of praise, the lances and arrows will be seen shining in the war-arena, besides the warriors, the ghosts and fiends will also be seen shouting loudly in the war. Somewhere the lances and the arrows will be seen striking the targets, many will be thrown in all the ten directions by catching them from their hair. The warriors of red colour will be seen and the arrows will be struck like the rays of the sun, the glory of the warriors will be of different type and seeing them, the kinsuk flowers will also feel shy. The elephants, horses and chariot-riders will fight in such numbers that the poets will not be able to describe them, their songs of praise will be composed and they will be sung till the end of four ages. The stable warriors will fall upon their opponents from both sides and will shout “kill, kill” from their mouths, the weapons will strike from both sides and the volleys of arrows will be discharged.
8 Part 15.53: The warriors will shout, the clouds will be shy, the armies will fight and the arrows will be discharged. The warriors will be showered, there will be the twang of the bows, the sworeds will collide and the war will continue. The earth will thrust in and become fearful, the warriors will run away without getting shy. The ganas will see, they will hail, they will sing praises and smile. The warriors will fulful their promises and will look beautiful, even the gods will feel shy from them in the war-arena. In their fury, they will discharged arrows, during their fighting in the war, their swords will break. The warriors will thunder, and not run away, they will strike their blows with swords and will knock down their enemies. The horses will fight, the warriors will be killed and will ferry across the world-ocean. The gods will see and hail: they will utter “Bravo, Bravo” and will be pleased in their mind. The Lord is the cause of all victories and the remover of the enemies, He is the destroyer of the tyrants and is Full of Glory. He is the giver of suffering to the tyrants and is the ornamentation of the world, the praiseworthy Lord is the punisher of the enemies. He is the destroyer of the armies and is the striker of the sword, He is the creator of the world and also its supporter. He is Bewitching and Glorious, He is the Affliction-Giver for the enemies and the world remembers Him. He is the masher of the enemy and fulfiller of the promise, He showers the arrows with His bow. He is the Fascinator of women, Glorious and elegant, He allures the mind like the clouds of Sawan. He is the ornament of the world and is the sustainer of tradition, he is cool like the moon and bright-faced like the sun. He comes and gives comfort and happiness, seeing he thick clouds, he gets pleased like the peacock. He is Merciful Lord of the world, He is the ornament of the universe and the remover of suffering. He is the allurer of women and most beautiful, seeing his charming eyes, the deer are getting shy. His eyes are like the deer’s eyes and lotus, He is full of Mercy and Glory. He is the cause of the Iron Age and the redeemer of the world, He is Beauty-incarnate and even the gods become shy on seeing Him. Heis the worshipper of the sword and the Destroyer of the enemy, He is the giver of happiness and killer of the enemy. He is the Yaksha of water and the fulfiller of the promise, He is the Destroyer of the enemy and the masher of his pride. He is the creator and support of the earth and by pulling His bow, He showers the arrows. He glorious with the elegance of lakhs of moons, He is the Fascinatior of women with His Glorious Elegance. He has red colour, He supports the Earth and has infinite Glory. He is the field of Refuge, the Killer of the enemy, Most Glorious and Most Charming. His Beauty captivates he mind, He is the Cause of the causes of the world and is Full of Mercy. He is of such Captivating Beauty as if He is the god of love, His Brightness defeats the moon’s glory. He is the worshipper of the sword and the Destroyer of the enemy, He is the Lord bestower of the boon.
8 Part 15.54: The warriors are fighting in the war and the arrows are being discharged, the horse-riders are fighting in the battlefield and in their fury, they are absorbed in fighting. The dreadful fighting continues and the warriors have got enraged, the warriors are striking their lances and are dismounting the fighters from their horses. The soldiers have discharged the arrows and the horses have been killed and the fast-moving horses jumped and ran away. The battlefield was saturated with blood and the warriors became unconscious during their fight, the fighters arise, get enraged and strike blows in great excitement. Shiva is dancing and the cowards are running away, the warriors are fighting and are being struck by the arrows. The warriors are absorbed in fighting and the heavenly damsels are moving for wedding them, the warriors are looking at them and they are also fascinated by them. Their beauty allures the lovers like falling in the well, wherefrom they can never come out, these heavenly damsels have also drowned themselves in the sexual love of the beautiful warriors. The women are getting allured and there is brightness of their elegance, the warriors seeing them are playing on various kinds of musical instruments. The women, full of beauty and lust are dancing and the warriors, getting pleased are wedding them. The king, getting infuriated, manifested himself as KAL and in his anger, quickly advanced forward. The warriors shouted, the horses danced, the fighters died and the ghosts etc. became pleased. The warriors were being killed and the cowards began to run away, the king also fell upon the opponents and the musical instruments of war were played. The swords were broken and fires blazed, with the infliction of arrows the warriors ran hither and thither. Seeing the war, the goddess Kali also pleased in the sky, the Bhairav and ghosts etc. also in the battlefield.
8 Part 15.55: The swords broke and many weapons were shattered into bits, those warriors who fought, were chopped and ultimately only the king survived.
8 Part 15.56: On the destruction of his army, the king extremely agitated went forward and came at the front Getting extremely angry in his mind and moved forward in order to fight. Taking his other forces with him, he struck blows in many ways Many trumpets sounded there and the onlookers of war, also fell down in fear.
8 Part 15.57: All the warriors in their fury, took their arms and weapons in their hands, moved forward with persistence and shouting loudly fell upon the opponents The pulled their bows upto their ears and discharged their arrows and without moving backward even slightly they fought and fell. Taking angrily there bows an arrows in there hand they moved and the worriers were killed silectivly They were all fearlessly inflicting wounds and their limbs are falling down, but still they did not run away from the battlefield.
8 Part 15.58: By pulling their bows, the warriors are proudly discharging their arrows and are uniting arrows with arrows discharging swiftly the later arrows They are striking blows with zeal and the great fighters also having been wounded are running away. The Lord is moving forward, killing the enemies angrily and consciously and is striking his arrows on the opponents The warriors with chopped limbs are falling down in the battlefield and all their blood is oozing out from their bodies. The warriors come in rage, strike the swords and are killing the enemies while shouting They breath their last, but do not abandon the battlefield and seem splendid in this way, the women of gods are getting allured on seeing their beauty. The warriors are coming being bedecked with their swords and on this side the Lord in his fury is recognizing the real fighters After fighting and getting wounded, the warriors leave for abode of gods and there they are welcomed with songs of victory.
8 Part 15.59: All the warriors getting bedecked are falling upon the enemy and after fighting in the war, they reach heaven The persistent warriors run forward and endure the anguish of the wounds, their feet do not fall back and they are driving other warriors ahead. All the warriors are moving forward in anger and are embracing martyrdom in the battlefield Colliding their arms and weapons, they are striking blows and the stable warriors, who do not think of running away, are striking blows, persistently thundering fearlessly. The small and big drums, flutes, anklets etc. are creating sounds and the warriors firmly putting their feet on the earth are thundering angrily The persistent warriors recognizing others are entangled with them and there is such a run in the battlefield that the directions are not being comprehended. The lion of the goddess Kali, in order to kill the army, is running angrily in this way and wants to destroy the army in this way just as the sage August had completely drunk the ocean After killing the forces, the warriors are thundering and in the dreadful fight, their weapons are colliding.
8 Part 15.60: On the arrival of the army of the king, the Lord chopped many elephants, horses and chariots, the horses bedecked by the king were roaming in the battlefield, Somewhere neighing and somewhere the elephant were seen running, the warriors catching the hair of one another were engaged in fight with them, the arrows were being discharged like the wind and with them, the arrows were being discharged like the wind an Holding their arrows, bows and swords the great warriors fell upon, the warriors were striking blows from all the four directions, taking their swords, axes etc. in their hands There were groups of elephants fallen in the war on the side and support of their faces and they appeared like the mountains uprooted and thrown by Hanuman in the Rama-Ravana war. Taking the fourfold army, the Lord was attacked through elephants through the persistent warriors were chopped, but still they did not retrace their steps Enduring the blows of bows, swords and other weapons and dyed with blood, the Lord looked like one who had played Holi in the spring season. When wounded, the Lord was greatly enraged and he took his weapons in his hands, he penetrated into the army of the enemy and killed all of it in an instant He fell upon the warriors and he seemed splendidly beautiful as if the had given the ornaments of wounds to all the warriors in the battlefield. The Lord Kalki, bedecked his limbs with weapons, and in great rage, went forward, many musical instruments including drums were played in the war-arena Seeing that dreadful war, the matted locks of Shiva were also loosened and both the gods and demons fled away, all this happened at that time when Kalki thundered in rage in the battlefield. The horses, elephants, and kings were killed in the battlefield, the Sumeru mountain trembled and thrust into the earth, the gods and demons both became fearful All the seven oceans and all the rivers dried up in fear all the people trembled, the guardians of all the directions were wonder-struck as to who had been attacked in anger by Kalki. Holding his bow and arrows, Kalki, killed crores of enemies, the legs, heads and swords lay scattered at several places, the Lord rolled all in the dust The elephants, horses, chariots and camels were lying dead, it seemed that the battlefield had become and arrows and Shiva was looking for it, roaming hither and thither. The inimical kings, filled with shame ran in all the four directions and they again began to strike blows taking up their swords, maces, lances etc. with double zeal He, whosoever came to fight with that most powerful Lord, did not return alive, he died while fighting with the Lord and earning approbation, ferried across the Ocean of fear. With the currents of blood, having fallen on them, the elephants are seen dyed in beautiful colour, the Lord Kalki, in his fury, wrought such a havoc that somewhere the horses have fallen down and somewhere the superb warriors have been knocked down Though the warriors are definitely falling on the earth, but they are not retracing even two steps backwards, they all seen like the wrestlers playing Holi after drinking hemp. The warriors who warriors who survived, they attacked from all the four sides with greater zeal, taking their bows, arrows, maces, lances and swords in their hands, they glistened them Whipping their horses and waving like the clouds of Sawan, they penetrated into the enemy’s army, but taking his sword in his hand, the Lord killed many and many and many fled away. When the dreadful war was waged in this way, the warriors fled away, leaving behind their weapons, they put off their armours and throwing their weapons fled and then they did not shout Kalki, catching his weapons in the battlefield looks so charming that seeing his beauty, the earth, sky and nether-world were all feeling shy. Seeing the army of the enemy running away, Kalki holding his weapons his bow and arrows, his sword, his mace etc., mashed everyone in an instant The warriors ran away like the leaves before the blow of wind, those who took shelter, survived, the others, discharging their arrows fled away.
8 Part 15.61: Somewhere the warriors, gathering together, are shouting “kill, kill” and somewhere, getting agitated, they ae lamenting Many warriors are moving within their army and many after embracing martyrdom are wedding the heavenly damsels. Somewhere the warriors, discharging their arrows, are roaming and somewhere the afflicted warriors, leaving the battlefield, are running away Many are destroying the warriors fearlessly and many in their rage are shouting repeatedly “kill, kill”. The daggers of many are falling having been shattered into bits and many wielders of arms and weapons are running away in fear Many are roaming and fighting and embracing martyrdom are leaving for heaven. Many are dying while fighting in the battlefield and many after going through the universe are getting separated from it Many are striking blows with their lances and the limbs of many, being chopped, are falling down.
8 Part 15.62: Many warriors abandoning their shame, and leaving behind everything, are running away, and the ghosts, fiends and imps dancing in the battlefield, are ruling over it The gods and demons all are saying this that this war is dreadful like the war of Arjuna and Karan. The persistent warriors, in their fury, are striking blows and they appear like the furnaces of fire The kings in their ire are striking their weapons and arms, and instead of running away, they are shouting “Kill, Kill”. The gods and demons both are saying, Bravo!" Looking at the fighting, the earth, sky, neither-world and all the four direcitions trembling The warriors are not running away, but are thundering in the war-arena, seeing the glory of those warriors the women of Yakshas and Nagas are getting shy. The great warriors, getting enraged, have attacked and are waging a dreadful and frightening war Embracing martyrdom in the ear, they are meeting the heavenly damsels and this war appears as a great war to all the gods, demons and Yakshas.
8 Part 15.63: In order to kill Kalki, the warriors cautiously marched forward and began to wage war here, there and everywhere The brave warriors like Bhima are fearlessly striking blows and after fighting and embracing martyrdom, they are getting abode in the region of gods. Pulling their bows and discharging arrows, they are advancing towards the Lord and embracing martyrdom, they are going to the next world They are absorbed in fighting and are falling into bits before him, these warriors are falling into bits for the sake of heavenly damsels and are embracing death.
8 Part 15.64: The arrows of the warriors are crackling and the drums are rolling. The horses are neighing and the elephants are trumpeting in groups. The warriors are discharging arrows forcefully. The ghosts intoxicated in the hue of war, are dancing, in the battlefield. The sky is filled with heavenly damsels and they are all dancing. The swords are gleaming quickly and they are striking with clattering sound. The warriors are fighting in anger and are dying. The horses and horse-riders are lying unconscious in the battlefield. The elephants are running away and in this way, the kings, because of the disgrace of defeat, are feeling ashamed. The large daggers are striking blows on the limbs in the war-arena.
8 Part 15.65: In this way, innumerable army fought and the warriors, in anger, and discharging arrows and thundering advanced forward, hearing the dreadful sound, the cowards ran away. The warriors, in anger , marched forward with their contingents and taking out their swords, they bean to strike blows, the heaps of the corpses looked like the mountains lying on the sea-cost for building the dam. The limbs are being chopped, the wounds are oozing our and the warriors are fighting full of zeal, the adepts, minstrels and ballad-singers etc. are looking at the fighting and are also singing the praises of the heroes. Shiva, assuming his dreadful form, is dancing and his frightening tabor is being played, the goddess Kali is stringing the rosaries of skulls and is releasing the fire-flames, while drinking blood.
8 Part 15.66: The dreadful war-drums sounded, hearing which the cloud felt shy, the Kshatriyas fought in the battlefield and pulling their bows, discharged the arrows. The warriors, with the broken limbs, fell while dancing, being absorbed in fighting, the fighters drew out their daggers with double zeal. Such a terrible war was fought, that none of the fighters remained in senses, Kalki, the manifestation of Yama, was victorious and all the kings fled away. When all the kings fled away, then the king himself rotated and came in front and producing the terrible sound, he began the fighting. He was discharging his arrows as if the leaves were flying in the forest or the stars were falling from the sky. He caused great loss to the enemies with his arrows, the arrows of the great warriors were discharged from all the four sides. The arrows flew like the innumerable worms and locusts and they were countless in numbers like the particles of sand and the hair of the body. The arrows, with golden wings and steel tips, were discharged and in this way, the arrows with sharp tips were discharged on the Kshatriyas. The warriors began to fall in the battlefield and the ghosts and fiends danced, the fighters, getting pleased, showered arrows. The warriors challenging others in fury, inflicted wounds on them, with the collision of dagger with the dagger, the sparks of fire were emited. The horses danced and the ghosts roamed, the fiends, laughingly were absorbed in war. Shiva also fought, while dancing, and in this way, for ten days, this ire-full war was fought. Then the king, abandoning his spirit of bravery, ran for two steps, but then he rotated like the revengful snake. Then he again began the war and showered arrows, the warriors discharged arrows and the death released them from the terror of the war. All the adepts saw Kalki and repeated “bravo, bravo”, the cowards trembled on seeing him.
8 Part 15.67: The warriors aiming the targets of their arrows marched forward and embracing martyrdom in the war, they wedded the heavenly damsels The heavenly damsels, also being pleased, began to wed the warriors catching their hands after selecting them. The warriors, getting bedecked, fell on the direction of the opponents and striking sharp lances on the enemies The persistent fighters are falling down after continued fighting and gathering their forces, are running in various directions here and there.
8 Part 15.68: The king trembled, the dreadful war-drums sounded, the elephants went out of control and the warriors fought with one-another. The trumpets sounded and the warriors were killed, the bloody fighters fell and their zeal doubled. The adepts laughed and the groups of warriors ran away, the arrows were discharged and the warriors fought among themselves. There was the sound of arrows and the trumpets sounded, the kettledrums were played and the armies roamed. The cowards trembled and were killed in the battlefield, Many of them speedily ran away and felt shameful in their mind. The king was released and he ran away alongwith his army, with the discharge of arrows all the directions were covered. By discharging the arrows, the pride of all was mashed, with the infliction of arrows all the warriors were weakened, their weapons fell down from their hands. The flowers were showered from the sky and in this way, the trouble ended, the kalki incarnation in his fury, killed the king. The gods came from the front and catching the feet of the Lord eulogized him, the adepts also composed epics in Praise of the Lord. For eulogizing the Lord, the epics were sung and the praise of the Lord spread in all the four sides, the pious people began pilgrimages and the true devotees of the Lord began to dance.
8 Part 15.69: Ultimately, the king of Sambhal was killed, the small and large drums sounded, the warriors, frightened of war ran away and getting disappointed, they abandoned all the weapons. The gods showered flowers and everywhere the patron-god was worshipped, the people adored the dreadful goddess and many works were finalized. The beggars received charity and everywhere the poems were composed, the Yajnas, burning of incense, lighting of lamps, the charities etc. were all done according to vedic rites. The heads of hermitages, leaving all other works, worshipped the goddess, the powerful goddess was established again and in this way, there was propagation of the perfect Dharma. End of the chapter entitled “the Kalki Incarnation after killing the king of Sambhal becomes victorious-the description of the war of Sambhal” Bachittar Natak.
8 Part 15.70: Now begins the description of war with various countries.The king of Sambhal was killed and there was discussion regarding dharma in all the four directions, people made offerings to Kalki. While the whole of the country was conquered, kalki got infuriated and he reddening his eyes, called all his army. He sounded the horn of victory and he planted the column of war again, the whole army in great zeal, marched forward and the whole earth trembled. The earth trembled like the boat in water, the warriors moved with great excitement and the atmosphere was filled with dust on all the sides. All those who had canopies over their heads, got infuriated, taking with them all their armies, in anger, they marched like Indra or Vritasura. The glory of their armies is indescribable, all of them marched after bedcking themselves and the instruments of victory were played.
8 Part 15.71: Many bloody and great sword-wielders and armour-wearers were conquered, many Kandhari warriors, wearing large steel-armours, were destroyed, many elegant warriors of Rum country were killed and those great warriors swung and fell on the earth. The warriors of Kabul, Babylonia, Kandhar, Iraq and Balkh were destroyed an d they all, getting fearful, fled away. The warriors, abandoning their arms and weapons, assumed the garb of women and getting ashamed, left their own country, the elephant-riders, the horse-riders and chariot-riders were deprived of their kingdom and the warriors forsaking forbearance, became The negroes and people of other countries fled away, and in the same way, the barbarians of Armenia also ran away, there one of the warriors taking out his sword, caused his horse to dance between both the armies. The Lord, the Great Creator of the wars saw all this and the destroyer of the great canopied-kings, the Lord became enraged, that Lord was the conqueror of the noteworthy most tyrannical armies and he got terrible infuriated. He discharged arrows in great rage and the army of that king was chopped and knocked down, the corpses fell in groups, heaps of hands, waists and other broken limbs fell down. The crows shouted caw and the flames of fire arose creating crackling noise, the ghosts and fiends laughed there and the goddess Kali ran, while stringing the rosaries of skulls.
8 Part 15.72: The warriors, getting enraged, waged war and discharged arrows, they were shouting “kill, kill”, while showering arrows. Dancing in the mood of fighting, the warriors fell with broken limbs, and both the gods and demons, on seeing them said “bravo, bravo”.
8 Part 15.73: The Lord taking his sword in his hand, became filled with anger and began to roam in the battlefield in fighting mood, holding his bow and sword fearlessly and angrily, he began to move in the battlefield in a queer way. Holding various weapons and challenging with anger and persistence, he fell upon the opponents in war, holding his sword in his hand, he became engrossed in fighting and did not recede. Like the lightning of the rushing clouds, the swords gleamed, the army of the enemies did not even recede two steps backwards and in its fury, came to fight again in the war-arena. The persistent warriors were getting angry in the war like the furnace with blazing flames, the army revolved and gathered together and was engrossed in fighting with great rage. Thousands of swords were looking magnificent and it appeared that the snakes were stinging every limb, the swords seemed smiling like the flash of the dreadful lightning.
8 Part 15.74: The swords are glistening like the fires or like the smiling damsels or like the flashing lightning. While inflicting wounds, they are moving like the restless modifications of mind, the broken limbs are falling like meteors. The goddess Kalika is laughing in the battlefield and the frightening ghosts are shouting, just as the lightning is flashing, In the same manner, the heavenly damsels are looking at the battlefield and dancing. Bhairavi is shouting and the yoginis are laughing, the sharp swords fulfilling the desires, are striking the blows. The goddess Kali is seriously enumerating the corpses and filling her bowl with blood, is looking magnificent, she is moving carelessly and seems like a portrait, she is repeating the Lord’s Name. She is stringing the rosary of skulls and putting it around her neck, she is laughing, the ghosts are also visible there and the battlefield has become an unapproachable place.
8 Part 15.75: When the warriors waged a powerful war, many elegant fighters were killed, then Kalki thundered and bedecked with all the weapons, penetrated into the current of steel-weapons. There was such a thundering sound that the people were absorbed in the illusion and the dust of the horses’ feet arose high to touch the sky, because of the dust, the golden rays disappeared and the darkness prevailed, in that confusion, there was a showe In that dreadful war, the army, being destroyed, ran away and pressing straw between the teeth, it began to shout with humility, seeing this the king also abandoned his pride and ran away leaving behind his kingdom and all his paraphernalia. Many Kashmiri and patient, persistent and enduring warriors were chopped and killed and many canopied, many mighty Gurdezi fighters and fighters of other countries, who were siding that king with great foolishness, were defeated. The Russians,Turkistanis, Sayyads and other persistent and angry fighters were killed, the dreadful fighting soldiers of Kandhar and many other canopied and angry warriors were also made lifeless. With the discharge of arrows, the firearms wre discharged like the fires rising in clourds, Shiva, dancing with his pleasure, strung the rosaries of skulls, the warriors began to fight and wed the heavenly damsels after selecting them. Getting truncated and having the limbs broken the riders of elephants, the horses and other warriors began to fall in groups, the hearts of the warriors throbbed with each challenge and with the rising of the fighters with beautiful whiskers the earth bec
8 Part 15.76: He, who resisted before them, was killed and he, who was defeated, he surrendered, in this way, all were delightfully adjusted. So much charity was bestowed, that they can only be described by the poets, all the kings became happy and the horns of victory sounded. The Khorasan country was conquered and taking every-one with him, the Lord gave his mantra and Yantra to everyone. From there, sounding trumpets and taking all the army alongwith him he marched forward, the warriors had the swords and quivers, they were extremely angry and clashing warriors.
8 Part 15.77: The earth trembled and the Sheshnaga repeated Lord’s Names, the dreadful bells of war rang, the warriors in ire discharged arrows and shouted “kill, kill” from their mouth. Enduring the anguish of wounds, they began to inflict wounds and cut the good steel-armours in the battlefield, the ghosts and the vultures moved in the sky and the vampires shrieked vultures moved in the sky and the vampires shrieked violently. The heavenly damsels moved in the sky and they came to look for and take refuge with the warriors in the battlefield, they sang song from their mouths and in this way, the ganas and heavenly damsels roamed in the sky. Seeing the warriors, Shiva began to string the rosary of skulls and Yoginis laughed and moved, the fighters, roaming in the armies received wounds and in this way they began to fulfill their promise of conquering the West.
8 Part 15.78: Conquering the whole of the west, Kalki thought of moving towards the South and I do not relate the wars, that occurred there.
8 Part 15.79: Remembering the war, the Yoginis are hailing and the trembling cowards of the Iron Age also became fearless, the hags are laughing violently and Sheshnaga, getting dubious, is wavering. The gods are looking and saying “Bravo, bravo”, and the goddess getting glorious, is shouting, the flowing wounds inflicted by the swords are testing the warriors and the fighters alongwith their horses are enduring the cruelty of war. The goddess Chandi, riding on her lion, is shouting loudly and her glorious sword is gleaming, because of the ganas and heavenly damsels, the battlefield has become filled with dust and all the gods and demons are looking at this war. Seeing the radiant headless trunks, roaming in the war-arena, the gods are becoming pleased, the warriors are wedding the heavenly damsels in the battlefield and seeing the warriors, the Sun-god is withholding his chariot. The ghosts and fiends are dancing to the tune of drums, anklets, tabors, conche, fifes, kettledrums etc. Conquering the fearless kings of the West, in anger, kalki marched forward towards the Souh, the enemies, leaving their countries, ran away and the warriors thundered in the battlefield. The mighty ghosts and Baitals, danced, the elephants trumpetted and the heart-moving instruments were played the horses neighed and the elephants roared the swords in the hands of the warriors looked splendid.
8 Part 15.80: After killing the proud demons of the West, now the trumpets sounded in the South, there the warriors of Bijapur and Golkunda were killed the warriors fell and the goddess Kali, the wearer of the rosary of skulls, began to dance. The battles were fought with the residents of Setubandh and other ports and with the persistent warriors of Matasya Pradesh, the inhabitants of Telangana and the warriors of Dravir and Surat were destroyed. The honour of the king of Chand town mashed, the kings of Vidarbha country were suppressed in great ire after conquering and chastising the South, the Lord Kalki journeyed towards the East. End of the second chapter entitled “Kalki Incarnation, Victory over the South” in Bachittar Natak.
8 Part 15.81: After conquering the West and devastating the South, Kalki incarnation went towards the East and his trumpets of victory sounded. There he met the kings of Magadha, who were experts in eighteen sciences, on that side there were also fearless kings of Bang, Kaling, Nepal etc. Many kings who were equal in authority like Yaksha, were killed by adopting suitable measures and in this way, cruel warriors were killed and the land of the East was also snatched. The demons of evil intellect were killed and turned towards the North in great anger and after killing many dangerous kings, bestowed their kingdom on others. End of the chapter third entitled “Victory over the East” in Kalki incarmnation in Bachittar Natak.
8 Part 15.82: (Now begins the description of the twenty-fourth of the cities of the east and Killing the fighters of indestructible Glory the trumpets of Kalki incarnation sounded proudly. The warriors were again absorbed in war and showered arrows while thundering The cowards ran away in fear and their wounds burst. The warriors were bedecked The war-drums sounded, the ghosts danced in a charming manner, the Baitals shouted the goddess Kali laughed and the fire-showering tabor was played. The cowards ran away from the battlefield The ghosts, fiends and Baitals danced, the Shiva, engaged in Sport, began to string the rosaries of skulls and the warriors looking at the heavenly damsels covetously, wedded them. The warriors, inflicting wounds are falling upon the opponents and the ghosts are dancing and singing with zeal Shiva is dancing while playing on his tabor. The famous Gandharvas, the minstrels and adepts are composing poems in appreciation of war The gods playing their lyres, are pleasing the mind of sages. There is sound of innumerable elephants and horses and the drums of war are being played The sound is spreading in all the directions and the Sheshnaga is wavering on felling the loss of Dharma. The bloody swords have been drawn in the battlefield and the arrows are being discharged fearlessly The warriors are fighting and their secret parts are touching each other, the heavenly damsels are roaming in the sky enthusiastically. There are showers of lances and arrows and seeing the warriors, the heavenly damsels are getting pleased The drums and dreadful tabors are being and the ghosts and Bhairavas are dancing. The knocking sound of the sheaths and the clattering of swords is being heard The terrible demons are being crushed and the ganas and others are laughing loudly.
8 Part 15.83: The Kalki incarnation like Shiva, giver of happiness to all, mounting on his Bull, remained stable in the battlefield like the dreadful fires. He, assuming his great benign form, was destroying the afflicting agonies He was redeeming those who had taken shelter and was removing th effect of sin of the sinners. He was unfolding brilliance like the fire or the roasary of fire His dreadful form was radiating brightness like fire. The Lord of all the three worlds took his dagger in his hand and in his pleasure, he destroyed the demons.
8 Part 15.84: Conquering the invincible people and causing the warriors to run away like cowards and taking all his allies with him, he reached the kingdom of China. The angry and furious tone of the Kalki incarnation, who assumed royalty, is very queer Before him, the beauty of the women of Kamroop with bewitching eyes and the charm of Kamboj country is devoid of radiance. His drums, are his shields, his blows are severe, his musical instruments create loud sounds and his arrows raise anger and ire.
8 Part 15.85: He conquered the unconquerable, established the unestablished He broke the unbreakable and devided the indivisible, He broke the unbreakable and he destroyed those who resisted. The heavenly damsels, seeing both the brave and coward warriors were getting pleased They were all sprinkling roses, camphor nad saffron on the head of kalki incarnation. In this way, after conquering the three directions the trumpet sounded in the North He went towards China and Manchuria, where there were people in the garb of Rawalpanthis. The war-musical instruments were played and the warriors thundered Seeing the Lords, the heavenly damsels were filled with zeal, the gods and others, all were pleased and all of them, abandoning their pride began to sing songs. Listening to the news about the arrival of the army, the king of China caused the war-horns to be sounded in all his territory All the warriors marched for the war and in their fury, they began to discharge arrows. The bloody daggers came out and the great warriors died in the war The wounds were inflicted and the atmosphere became foggy with the dust of the feet of the warriors, the shouts of vultures were heard in all the four directions. The dreadful Kali laughed and the huge Bhairavas and the ghosts shouted, the arrows were inflicted The ghosts and fiends ate the flesh the cowards in their anxiety began to run away.
8 Part 15.86: The king of China attacked, he was ready in every way The bloody daggers came out of scabbards with double zeal. The warriors, getting enraged, discharged arrows and Roamed in the battlefield, destroying the limbs of others. Shiva also joined the armies and danced and discharged arrows in a queer way. The warriors in their fury discharged arrows in the battlefield The streams of blood were full and the heavenly damsels moved in the sky. The goddess kali laughed and produced fire of Yoga The tyrants were killed with the arrows of the soldiers. The warriors are swinging and falling on the ground and the dust is rising from the earth The fighters have gathered zealously in the battlefield and the ghosts and fiends are dancing. The king of China met his men, whose objectives were fulfilled He took many with himself and advanced forward.
8 Part 15.87: The king took all alongwith him and the drums of victory sounded The warriors gathered in the battlefield and seeing them, the heavenly damsels were allured The gods, demons and Gandharvas all were filled with wonder and pleased All ghosts, fiends and superb Vidyadharis wondered Kalki thundered as a manifestation of KAL and he was eulogized in various ways The destroyer of invincible warriors like Chandika, the Lord Kalki was being hailed. The armies fought with each other, the Sumeru mountain trembled, and the leaves of the forest quivered and fell Indra and Sheshnaga writhed on becoming agitated Ganas and others shrunk with fear, the elephants of he directions wondered The moon was frightened and the sun ran hither and thither, the Sumeru mountain wavered, the Tortoise became unsteady and all the oceans dried up in fear The meditation of Shiva was shattered and the burden on the earth could not remain in equilibrium The water sprang up, the wind flowed and the earth staggered and trembled. With the discharge of arrows, the directions were covered and the mountains were pulverized Of war, the sage Dhruva trembled Brahma abandoned the Vedas and ran away, the elephants fled and Indra also left his seat The day on which the Kalki incarnation, thundered in rage in the battlefield On that day, the dust of the hoofs of the horses, springing up, covered the whole of the sky It seemed that in his rage the Lord had created the additional eight skies and six earths. On all the four sides, all including Sheshnaga are wondering The heats of the fish also throbbed, the ganas and others ran away from the war-arena The crows and vultures violently hovered over the corpses and Shiva, the manifestation of KAL, is shouting in the battlefield, without dropping the dead from his hands The helmets are breaking, the armours are being torn and the armoured horses are also getting frightened the cowards are running away and the warriors seeing the heavenly damsels are getting allured by them.
8 Part 15.88: When Lord Kalki became infuriated, then the war-horns sounded, and there was jingling sound The Lord held up his bow and arrow and the sword and taking out his weapons, he penetrated amongst the warriors. When the king of Manchuria was conquered, on that day, the war-drums sounded The Lord, causing loud lamentation, snatched away the canopies of various countries and got his horse moved in all the countries. When China and Manchuria were conquered, then Lord kalki advanced further in the North O my Lord! to what extent I should enumerate the kings of the North, the drum of victory sounded on the heads of all. In this way, conquering various kings, the musical instruments of victory was played O my Lord! they all left their countries and went here and there and the Lord Kalki destroyed the tyrants everywhere. Many types of yajnas were performed, the kings of many counties were conquered O Lord! the kings came from various countries came with their offerings and you redeemed the saints and destroyed the evil ones. Religious discussions were held everywhere and the sinful acts were totally finished O Lord! The Kalki incarnation came home after his conquests and the songs of felicitation were sung everywhere. Then the end of the Iron Age came very near and all came to know about this mystery The Kalki incarnation comprehended this mystery and felt that Satyuga was about to begin.
8 Part 15.89: Everyone heard that Satyuga had come The sages were pleased and ganas etc. sang songs of praise. This mysterious fact was comprehended by all The sages believed but did not feel it. The whole world saw that mysterious Lord, whose elegance was of a special type. He, the fascinator of the mind of the sages, looks splendid like a flower and who else had been created equivalent in beauty like him?
8 Part 15.90: After the end of Kalyuga, Satyuga came and the saints enjoyed bliss everywhere They sang and played their musical instruments, Shiva and Parvati also laughed and danced. The tabors and other musical instruments were played like the gongs and the weapons-wielding warriors got pleased The songs were sung and everywhere there was talk about the wars fought by Kaki incarnation.
8 Part 15.91: After killing the enemies and taking the group of kings alongwith him, the Kalki incarnation bestowed charities here there and everywhere After killing the powerful enemies like indra the Lord getting pleased and also getting approbation, came back to his home. After conquering the enemies, he fearlessly performed many hom-yajnas and removed the sufferings and ailments of all the beggars in various countires After removing the poverty of Brahmins, like the kings of Kuru clan, the Lord on conquering the worlds and spreading his glory of victory, marched towards Conquering the world, spreding the praise of the Vedas and thinking about the good works, the lord subdued fighting all the kings of various countries On becoming the axe of Yama, the Lord conquered all the three worlds and sent his servants with honour everywhere, bestowing great gifts on them. On destroying and punishing the tyrants, the Lord conquered the materials of the value of billions Subduing the warriors, he conquered their weapons and crown and the canopy of Kali-incarnation revolved on all the four sides.
8 Part 15.92: His light shone like the sun The whole world unhesitatingly adored him. Before his great beauty, all the kings felt shy All of them accepted defeat and made offerings to him. The warriors equivalent to his glory also felt shy His words are very sweet and his eyes are full of enjoyment and pleasure. His body is so beautiful as if it was especially fashioned The women of gods and saints are getting pleased. He who saw him even slightly, his eyes kept on looking at him The women of gods, getting allured are looking with love towards him. Seeing the beauty-incarnate Lord, the god of love is feeling shy The enemes are so much fearful in their mind as if they have been ripped by the weapons. The warriors are looking at his glory covetously His eyes are black and touched with antimony, which seem to have awakened continuously for several nights. Filled with beauty and love they look magnificent like a comedian king. The black arrows are fitted in the bow and they hit the enemies.
8 Part 15.93: He leads the life of a producer, a king, an authority, bestower of fortune and love. He is a Soverign, an arms-wielding warrior, elehance-incarnate an the creator of the whole world. He is lustful like the god of love, blooming like a flower an dyed in love like a beautiful song. He is cobra for a female serpent, deer for the does, a canopied Sovereign for the kings and a devotee before the goddess Kali.
8 Part 15.94: In this way Kalki incarnation conquered all the kings and ruled for ten lakh and twenty thousand years .
8 Part 15.95: RAVAN-He caught his sword in his hand and knocked down everyone in the war and there was no delay in the change of destiny. He gave his mantra to everyone, he abandoned all the Tantras and sitting in solitude, he produced his Yantras.
8 Part 15.96: Many people got allured by his various beautiful forms In the language of the Vedas, his Glory was infinite. Seeing his many garbs, charms and glories, the sings fled away. Those who were special powerful people composed of various forms, The Lord killed these innumerable enemies and obtained approbation in the world. The Lord is most powerful with indestructible arms and his pure light looks splendid He is removing the sins by performing the hom-yajna.
8 Part 15.97: When he conquered the whole world, his pride was extremely increased He also forgot the unmanifested Brahmin and said this583 “There is no second except me and the same is accepted at all the place I have conquered the whole world and made it my slave and have caused everyone to repeat my name. I have given life again to the traditional and have swung the canopy over my head All the people consider me as their own and none other comes to their sight. No one the repeats the name of the Lord-God or the name of any other God goddess ” Seeing this the Unamanifested Brahma created another purusha. Mehdi Mir was created, who was very angry and persistent one He killed the Kalki incarnation within himself again. Those who conquered, the made it there possession they are all under the control of KAL in the end In this way, with complete improvement the description of twenty-fourth incarnation is completed. End of the description of twenty-fourth incarnation in Bachittar natak.
8 Part 15.98: In the way, destroying him, the age of the truth was manifested The whole of Iron Age had passed away and the light manifested itself everywhere consistently .1 Then Mir Mehdi, conquering the whole world, was filled with pride He also got the canopy swung over his head and caused the whole world to bow at his feet. Expect himself, he did not have faith in anyone He who did not comprehend One Lord-God, he ultimately could not save himself from KAL. There is not one other in all colours and forms except one God He, who has not recognized that one Lord, he wasted his birth. Expect that one Lord, there is none other in water, on plain and all the places He who had not recognized the One Reality, he only roamed away amongst the Yogis. He who leaving the one, believed in another one, in my view, he is devoid of wisdom He will be surrounded by suffering, hunger, thirst and anxiety throughout day and night. He will never get peace and will always be surrounded by ailments He will always suffer death on account of suffering and hunger, he will always remain restless. The leprosy will prevail in his body and all his body will rot His body will not remain health and his foundness for sons and grandson will always afflict him. His family will be destroyed and at the and, his body will not be redeemed also He will always be engrossed in disease and sorrow, ultimately, he will die the death of a dog . Reflecting over the egoistic state of Mir Mehdi the Unmanifested Brahman thought of killing him He created an insect, which entered the ear of Mir Mehdi. Entering his ear, that insect conquered that base fellow, and Giving him various types of suffering, killed him in this way. End of the description of twenty-fourth incarnation in Bachittar natak.

10 Part 1.1: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru. The Lord is One and He can be realized through the Grace of the True Guru.Now I describe in chastened form those incarnations, which were assumed by Rudra Performing extreme austerities Rudra became egoistic. He did not consider anyone equal to him in all place and countries, then Mahakal in ire said to him thus “Those who become proud, they deliberately perform the action of falling into a well O Rudra! Listen to me attentively that my name is also the destroyer of ego. “Brahma had also become egoistic in his mind and the evil notions arose there, but when he took birth for seven times, he was then redeemed. “O the king of sages! listen to what I say and in the same way, you may go and take birth on the earth Otherwise, O Rudra! You will not be redeemed in any other way.” Hearing this, Shiva, considering the Lord as the destroyer of ego, and leaving his persistence, incarnated on earth.
10 Part 1.2: The way, in which all the kings have been described, in the same way, the actions done by all the sages have been narrated as to how Rudra manifested himself in the castes of dvijas. Whatever deeds they brought to light, I relate them here In this way, rudra became the sons of the sages, who adopted silence and attained recognition. Then he incarnated himself as sage Atrl, who the store of eighteen sciences He abandoned everything else and adopted Yoga as his way of life and served Rudra, the store of all wealth. He performed austerities for a long time, on which, Rudra got pleased and said, “You may ask for any boon which you like, I shall grant it to you.” Then the sage Atri stood up with folded hands and his love for Rudra was further increased in his mind He became very happy the tears flowed form his eyes and his hair showed signs of jubilation, when he said11 “O Rudra! if you want to grant me a boon, then give me a son like you ” Rudra saying “let it be”, disappeared and the sage came back to his home. On returning, he married Ansuya, who had been blessed by Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu by their Lustre. Ansuya also, in consonance with her name, inspection being a charming lady, performed austerities She was extremely lustrous and glorious and it appeared that she was the second manifestation of the goddess of love. That pretty and married fortunate woman was glorious in various ways on seeing whom, the personification of beauty also got allured her glory is indescribable. Seeing her face, the moon was filled with jealousy and wept in affection Seeing her hair, he bowed down her looks and even the Sumeru mountain, seeing her beauty, concealed himself. Seeing her neck, the female pigeon got enraged and the parrot seeing her nostril hid himself in the forest Seeing her hair, even Yamuna was filled with anger and seeing her serenity, the ocean felt shy. Seeing her arms, the lotus-stalk felt she and the swans, seeing her gait got angry Seeing her legs, the Kadli trees became shyful and the moon considered his beauty inferior to her. In this way, the charm of her beauty is described, and no poet can utter her greatness Seeing such a beauteous lady, the sage Atri believed that he had obtained canopied kingdom of beauty. That lady had vowed that she would not marry her husband for sexual enjoyment, and would wed that person, who would have the strength to endure the sacred tribulations of austrerities. The sage had agreed with her vow and married her and sacrificed himself on her charm of beauty He, the sage Atri, who was the father of Dattatreya, making her his wife, brought her home.
10 Part 1.3: Several years passed after marriage and once an opportunity arose when Brahma and other gods went to the home of that sage the women of the hermitage of the sage performed great service to them. The incense was burnt, the lamps were lighted, there were libations and salutations Seeing Indra, Vishnu and Shiva, all the devotees eulogized them. Seeing the devotion of the sage, all were pleased and all blessed him Then Brahma said, “O Kumar! You will be blessed with a son.”
10 Part 1.4: When Brahma said this that the save would be blessed with a son, then listening to it, her eyes showed signs of anxiety. The body of that young lady became agitated and the tears flowed form her eyes She was filled with anxiety on hearing these words and she felt that the day had changed into night. Her body was agitated with anxiety and she getting enraged, became impatient, lips and eyes quivered and she lamented.
10 Part 1.5: Hearing these words that doe-eyed and extremely beautiful lady. Her mind, which was immaculate, was filled with extreme rage alongwith other women of the sages. The wife of the sage plucked her hair at that place and her comely limbs were filled with extreme ire. Breaking her necklaces, she plucked her hair and began to put dust hr head.
10 Part 1.6: Seeing the wife of the sage in anger, getting fearful and forsaking his pride, and taking Shiva and other sages with him, Brahma fled. Then the wife of the sage, uprooting one of the matted lock of ther head in anger, strumck it on her hand, at that time Dattatreya was born. Considering Ansuya as his mother and keeping her on his right, he circumambulated around her and then saluted her In this way, thinking about the experience of sexual pleasure, Dutt Kumar was born. His body was charming and he was reciting seven Smrities The great Dutt was reciting all the four Vedas. Shiva, remembering the earlier curse assumed himself the body of Dutt and Took birth in the home of Ansuya this was his first incarnation.
10 Part 1.7: The loving Dutt, the store of eighteen sciences was born He was the knower of Shastras and had a charming figure he was Yogi king of all the ganas. He spread the cults of Sannyas and Yoga and he was totally spotless and servitor of all He was the apparent manifestation of Yoga, who abandoned the path of royal pleasure. He was greatly praiseworthy, had a charming personality and also the store-house of Grace His disposition was radiant like sun and fire and had cool temperament like water he manifested himself as the king of Yogis in the world. Dutt Dev was superior to all in Sannyas Ashrama and was becoming incarnation of Rudra His radiance was like fire and power of Rudra his radiance was like fire and power endurance like earth. Dutt was a person of purity, indestructible splendour and pure intellect Even the gold feel shy before him and the waves of the Ganges seemed to surge over his head. He had long arms and charming body and was a detached supreme Yogi When he applied the ashes to his limbs, he fragranced everyone around him and he brought to light Sannyas and Yoga in the world. The praise of his limbs seemed boundless and he manifested himself as a generous king of the Yogis The brilliance of his body was infinite and from his great personality, he appeared to be a silence-observing ascetic and eminently glorious. That king of the Yogis spread his infinite greatness and glory and on his manifestation, the fraudulent tendencies trembled and he made them stingless in an instant. Seeing his indestructible greatness and unique body, the mother remained wonder-struck All the people in counties far and near also marveled to see him and all of them abandoned their pride on listening to his greatness. The whole nether-world and sky had the feeling about his comeliness which made all the creatures full of joy Because of him, the whole earth became blissful. The sky and the earth all quivered and the sages here and there abandoned their pride On his manifestation, many instruments were played in the sky and for ten days, the presence o f night was not felt. Many musical instruments were played here and there and it appeared that the discriminating intellect had assumed a body itself His glory is indescribable and he manifested himself as the king of ‘Sannyas’. Even on taking birth, he absorbed himself in actions of Yogs And he, destroying sins, propagated Dharma the great Sovereign fell at his feet and getting up, they practiced Sannyas and Yoga. Seeing the unique king Dutt, all the king bowed respectfully at his feet Seeing the greatness of Dutt, it appeared that he was the store of eighteen sciences. On his head, there were the matted locks of his celibacy and on his hands grew the nails of observances The white ashes on his body were indicative of his state devoid of illusions his character like Brahm was his deer skin. Having white ashes on his face and wearing loin-cloth, he was the possessor of Sannyas and conduct and relinquisher of deceit He remained absorbed in abstract meditation and his limbs were extremely charming his radiance was indestructible. In his mind there was only one desire of Sannyas and Yoga and for this desire he had abandoned all other desires His body was unique and during day and night, he remained detached from the deceits of the world leaving the desires of all kinds, he had adopted the character of sages his eyes were red and were the store of Dharma. He had a pure mind, devoid of vices, and he meditated with his non-mercurial eyes His praise was infinite having only one desire in his mind of adopting Sannyas from all sides he was the greatest among the immaculate Sannyasis. He had a body of Yogis, whose greatness was infinite and he was the store of the knowledge of Shrutis and extremely generous Amongst the sages, he was most skilful and great and was supremely learned. The sin had not even touched him and he was elegant in virtues The Yogi Dutt wore loin-cloth and seeing him, mother was wonder-struck. Seeing the greatest Sannyasi Dutt, having comely limbs, even the god of love felt shy The sage Dutt was the king of Sannyasis and he had practiced all kinds of the activities of Sannyas. His body was immaculate, which had never been troubled by lust On his head there was a tuft of matted locks such a form was adopted by Dutt, the incarnation of Rudra. Who can describe his fine glory ? And listening to his appreciation, the Yakshas and Gandharvas become silent Brahma was also wonder-struck to see his glory and even the god of love felt shy on seeing his beauty. He was extremely learned, expert in actions, beyond the desires and obedient to the Lord His elegance was like the crores of suns and the moon was also wonder-struck on seeing him. He had manifested as the apparent form of yoga and then had been absorbed in the practice of Yoga That immaculate Dutt of pure intellect did the first thing of leaving his home. When he practiced Yoga for a long time, Kaldev was pleased with him At that time, there was a heavenly voice “O king of Yogis! Listen to what I say.”
10 Part 1.8: Voice from heaven addressed to Dutt :“O Dutt! Listen to me with pure intellect I say unto you that there can be no salvation without the Guru first of all, adopt a Guru, then you will be redeemed, in this way, KAL told the method of Yoga to Dutt.
