Seeing the one with white canopy, white chariot and white horses and holding white weapons, the gods and men flee in illusion The god Chandra is astonished and the god Surya, seeing his glory is also wavering O king! this beauty belongs to Vivek, who may be considered extremely powerful The sages and kings pray before him in all the three worlds. He, on whom the fly-whisk is swinging from all the four sides and seeing whom, the swans of Mansarover feel shy He is extremely pure, glorious and beautiful He allures the mind of all the gods, men, Nagas, Indra, Yakshas, kinnars etc The day on which Vivek of such beauty will be ready to discharge his arrow, he will not discharge it on anyone else except Avivek. He is extremely powerful, vice-less, lustrous and incommensurably strong He is extremely glorious warrior and his drum sounds at all places including water and plain His chariot moves with the speed of wind and seeing his speed, even the lightning feels shy in its mind Hearing him thundering violently, the clouds of all the four directions flee in confusion He is considered unconquerable, fearless and a superb warrior in water and on plain, this invincible and mighty one is named Endurance by the world. The Dharma-incarnate Endurance is extremely powerful in most difficult times He is like Elysian tree and chops the evil modification with his sword He is extremely glorious, brilliant like the fire, he blazes all in the war with his speech He does not care even for Brahma-astra and Shiva-astra When this warriors named Suvriti will strike his arms and weapons in the war, and else will be able to fight with him except Kuvriti. This glorious one of indestructible body and brilliance, completely strong like fire and driving his chariot with the speed of wind, all the beings in water and on plain know him He is a skilful archer, but because of his fasting all his limbs are weak All the men and women know him by the name of Sanjamveer When, holding his bow and arrow, he will thunder in his superb form, then none can withhold him except Kuvriti. He is a mighty warrior named Nem, his chariot is drawn by comely and restless horses He is extremely skilful, soft-spoken and allures the mind like lyre He is supremely glorious and is the destroyer of enemies of all the world His sword is indestructible and he proves to be very strong in severe wars He is said to be dearless, indestructible, the Lore of consciousness, vice-less and unconquerable. He is a warrior infinite glory, fearless and eternal His chariot is volatile and lustrous like lightning Seeing him, the enemies, getting fearful, run away from war-arena Looking at him, the warriors forsake their patience and the warriors cannot discharge arrows persistently This powerful hero known by the name of Vigyan In the country of a Agyan, the people fear him in every home. He blazes like fire, sounds like the dreadful tabor and roars like the thundering clouds Holding his lance, he springs and strikes his blow on the enemy Seeing him, all the gods and demons hail him The day on which this warrior named Snan will thunder takinghis bow in his hand, On that day, none else will be able to obstruct him except Malinta. The first warrior is Nivratti and the second warrior is Bhavana, Who are extremely powerful, indestructible and invincible When these warriors, holding their weapons, will thunder in the battlefield, seeing them there the fighters will run away Those warriors will tremble like the yellow leaf and lose patience In this way the day on which these mighty ones will begin fighting, Then the fighters in the field will forsake their arms and weapons and no one will survive.
10 Part 2.13: When the warriors will confront one another, the warriors horns will be blown The lances will break and the corpses will be scattered The Bhairavas and ghosts will run and the adepts will see this spectacle The Yakshas and Yoginis will hail the warriors When the warriors named Sanjam will thunder in fury, then he will not be opposed by anyone else except Durmat. When this hailing warrior yoga will shout in fury, then the swords will create sensation and there will be loot and destruction When he will hold the weapons and wear armour, on the same day all the enemies will flee away, without staying for a moment With yellow faces they will run away on that day, the day on which he, unconquerable warrior will throw his glances on all. When five evils, getting enraged and angry, will stand firmly in the flesd, Then all will run away forsaking their arms and weapons like the leaves flying away before the wind When the warriors will cause their running horses to dance, then all the good modifications, forgetting themselves, will experience their downfall.
10 Part 2.14: The pretty fly-whisks are swinging and the beauty of this hero is fascinating His white garments, white horses and white weapons look splendid He is extremely immaculate, vice-less, invariable, indivisible and invincible warrior, whose glory is infinite and who is unconquerable and never deceivable, O king! on the day, then holding his arms and weapons, he will thunder, then no one will be able to stay before him and even obstruct him. Vidya and Lajja are also extremely glorious They are large-bodies, powerful and indestructible Their glory is extremely strong and indivisible They are mighty ones, long-armed and broad-shouldered like a bull In this way, the day on which these two warriors, they will sound their trumpet, then all the kings, forsaking their modesty will run away and none of them will confront them.
10 Part 2.15: There is one warriors named Sanjog, who is considered glorious in every home He is called unpunishable, invincible and fearless What description be given about him ? 244 There is another powerful warrior seen in this sphere of stars His name is Sukriti and he is considered unconquerable When he comes out thundering bedecked with his weapons and mounted on his chariot, then he looks supremely glorious like the sun. Holding his special arrow, sword etc., when this warrior named Amodh will thunder, And when he will be accompanied by the second thundering warriors Alobh, then infinite forces of the riders of chariots, elephants and horses will run away. You may see many warriors, lustrous and unpunishable like the sun, who may be persistent ones, worshippers, ascetics and truthful ones But this unconquerable and pure-limbed warriors is Akaam. When this warrior named Akrodh will be there in the battlefield in this fury, then all the fighters, forgetting their modesty, will run away He is the same warrior whose body is indivisible, whose form is powerful and who is modest. When this ego-less warrior of the supreme essence will thunder, he will especially destroy army and will oppose many fighters Many warriors getting together, taking their unfailing weapons will encounter him in great fury and many warriors, the bows and the dreadful armours will break up.
10 Part 2.16: All the warriors will emotionally get enraged will fall upon the enemy and look magnificent like many suns The warriors will join hands to destroy the forces of the enemies They will break up the forces constituting the tyrannical fighters. The warriors after stepping back will strike their lances and enduring the anguish of many wounds, they will kill innumerable forces The sword flashing like lightning will create sensation amongst warriors and will chop and throw away their limbs. Turning like lions, the warriors will strike lances and will churn the army of the chief generals The warriors mutually moving away at a distance, will come to fight with the enemy’s forces in such a way that the gods, demons, Yakshas, Kinnars etc. will not recognize them. Riding enthusiastically on horses, the warriors will throw the pike immediately and will chop down the infinitely glorious warriors O king! the warriors named Prem is a significant fighter, whose greatness is known in all the there worlds. This warrior of sun-like unique beauty, the killer of enemies, is known by the name of Sanjog There is also another warriors named Shaani, whom all the people recognize as glorious and powerful. This warrior of indivisible and powerful beauty looks highly infuriated like a lion His name is Supaath Both Surya and Chandra are a witness to it hat he never runs away from war. He has one disciple, who is known by the name Sukran and is considered a warrior of indestructible brilliance in the whole universe When that warrior in his fury, thundering like the lion and clouds, will fall upon the enemy, then the dreadful musical instruments will be played and many weapons will strike the blows. There is another warriors Suyang, the second is Prabodh and the third warrior is Daan, who is indivisible persistent There is another warrior named Suniyam, who has conquered the whole world The whole universe and the sun are its witnesses. There is another warrior Susatya and another one is Santokh The third one is Tapsaya, who has subjugated all the ten directions Another glorious warrior is Japa., Who after conquering many wars has assumed detachment.
10 Part 2.17: An extremely powerful and potent warrior is named Niyam the second warrior is Prem, Third one is Snjam and the fourth one is Dhairya And the sixth one is Panayama and the sixth one is called Dhyan This great warriors is considered extremely truthful and gloruiou, He is also known by the name Dharma by the gods, demons, Nagas, and Gandharvas. Shubh Acharan is considered the second warrior The third warrior is Vikram and the fourth one is mighty Buddh The fifth one is Anuraktata and the sixth warrior is Samadhi Uddam, Upakaar etc. are also unconquerable, invincible and ineffaceable Seeing them, the enemies forsake their seat and run away, while deviating from their position The glory of these mighty warrior is spread all over the earth.
10 Part 2.18: There is a warrior named Suvichar, who has many qualities There is another warriors named Sanjog, who had even conquered Shiva. There is one warrior named Hom, who has made the enemies impatient Another one is Pooja, who is unequalled in courage by anyone. The chief of all the warriors is Anuraktita In the same way, there is none like Virakt. Seeing Satsang and Bal, the enthusiasm for fighting is increased and In the same way, the warrior named Saneh is terribly powerful. There are also Har-Bhakti and Preet with whose light, the whole world is enlightened The path of Yoga of Dutt is also superb and is considered superior at all the places. Seeing the war, Krodh and Prabodh, in their fury, souding their trumpets, marched for attack after decorating their forces.
10 Part 2.19: In this way, arranging their forces and sounding their trumpets, the attack was made The way, in which the war was fought, it presents its description.
10 Part 2.20: The arms arose, the warriors fought The trumpets and other musical instruments were played. The lances with tassels were lustrous like fire-flames The warriors taking them began to fight with one another and there was lamentation. The elephants trumpetted, the musical instruments were played The warriors fought and the armours werr torn. The tabors were played the Bhairavas wandered in the battlefield And the warriors saturated with blood fell in the fighting. Decorated with arms and weapons, The warriors like Chamuda came to the war-arena. The warriors were decorated and the trumpets were sounded The fighters were enraged like fire and they were not even slightly in senses. The warriors were pleased in the war like the fish in water They were striking blows with their arms and weapons, desirous of getting victorious. The bows are infuriated The warriors are looking splendid and they are destroying the army. The goddess Kali is laughing, the Bhairavas are thundering and holding their vassels in the hands, The Yoginis have gathered together for drinking blood. The goddess is resplendent and the goddess Kali is shouting, The Bhairvas are thundering and are sounding their tabors. There is shower of weapons and the dreadful arms are crackling The arms of the demons are being discharged from one side and the arms of gods are being used form the other side. The Shailastras, Pavanastras and Meghastras are being showered and the fire-arms are crackling. The Hansastras, Kakastras and Meghastras are being showered and the Shukarastras are crackling. The warriors are bedecked, the Vyomastras are thundering the Yakshastras are being discharged and the Kinnarastras are getting exhausted. The Gandharvastras are being discharged and the Narastras are also being used The eyes of all the warriors are restless and all are uttering,”I”. The warriors saturated with blood have fallen in the war-arena and with the sounds of arms weapons, the warriors are also thundering. The groups of the red-eyed heavenly damsels are roaming in the sky for the warriors. The horses in flocks are roaming hither and thither and the warriors in their anger, are segmenting them. The meditation of the great Sannyasi Shiva has been broken and even he is listening to the thundering of Gandharvas and the playing of the musical instruments. The voice of the shower of Papastras and the crackling of Dharmastras is being heard Arogastras and Bhogastras are also being discharged. Vivadastras and Virodhastras, Kumantrastra, Karodhastras and Virodhastras were shwered and Vimohastras crackled. Charitrastras were shot, the Mogastrass collided, The Trasastras rained and Krodhastras crackled.
10 Part 2.21: In this way, many warriors of king Vivek were given a jerk and they left their arms and weapons Then the king himself moved and many types of musical instruments were played. The trumpets sounded form both the sides and there were thundering noises The rain of arrows spread on the whole sky and the ghosts and fiends also got entangled. There was steady rain of iron from the sky and there was testing of the great warriors alongwith it The innumerable warriors gathered together and got contracted there was dreadful mist on all the four sides. The king Vivek, getting enraged gave orders to his whole army all those warriors who arrayed themselves in an army All those warriors who arrayed themselves in an army rushed forward, the poet now tells their names. The warriors wearing helmets on their heads and armour is on their bodies and Bedecked with various kinds of arms and weapons, marched for fighting the water of the streams dried up in fear.
10 Part 2.22: The deadly musical instruments were played form both the directions and the trumpets thundered The warriors fighting on the strength of both their arms, rushed forward with the zeal for fighting in their mind.
10 Part 2.23: The warriors thundering in the battlefield and the kettledrums and conches etc. sounded there There was terrible uproar of warrior The arms and weapons were struck and the ghosts and fiends danced. Holding the sword, the prominent warriors were fragmented and the high-speed horses ran before the Vaitals in the battlefield The war-horns were blown and the warriors thundered The horses danced and the mighty warriors struck their blows while turning over. The horses neighed and the bodies of the mighty warriors writhed There was clattering of the arms and weapons and the adepts and Yogis, getting intoxicated began to dance with the tune of the weapons. The dreadful goddesses Kali and Kamakhya shrieked violently and the worriors throwing fire-arms and the Vaitals and Vultures terribly shouts The sixty-four Yoginis wearing rosaries saturated with blood enthusiastically threw the flames of Yoga. The sharp knives were thrown in the field, which caused the galloping horses to become furious and the blood of the warriors oozed out and flowed The horses to good races looked splendid and the Kandhari, Samundari and other types of horses also wandered. The speedy horses of Kutch state were running and the horses of Arabia, while running looked like the mounts flying with wings The dust which arose, covered the sky like this and there was so much mist that the night seemed to have fallen. From one side, the followers of Dutt ran and from the second side other people All atmosphere became dusty and the chopped corpses fell The vows of the great vows-observing warriors broke and they enthusiastically mounted on the horses of Tattar and began to dance. The dust from the hoofs of the horses covered the chariot of the sun and it deviated from its path and was not seen on the earth There was great stampede and the arms and weapons swords, shears, daggers etc. were struck. Holding his arrow, Dutt, discharged it on others and without seeing, the whole army ran away Only one warriors conquered all and many warriors fled The feet of the warriors were uprooted like the uprooting of the old Palaash trees by the wind. Getting enraged in the war, Lobh caused his horse to run Whosoever ran away from him, was saved, he stood there, was killed with a jerk The warrior named Alobh, seeing him, returned and Lobha discharged so many arrows, which spread over the sky. He attacked with ten arrows on the warrior named Dhairya and he discharged sixty arrows on, making Sanjam as his target He pierced the limbs of Nem with his nine arrows and with twenty arrows, he attacked the mighty warrior Vigyan. He attacked Pavitarta with twenty-five arrows and Arcchana with eighty arrows, whose limbs were chopped by him He destroyed the complete Pooja with eighty-five arrows he beat Lajja with his big staff. Eighty-two arrows were discharged on Vidya and thirty-three on Tapasya: The limbs of Keerti were pierced with innumerable arrows The warriors like Alobh etc. were dealt with nicely. He pierced Nir-Ahamkara with eighty arrows and also touched with his arms the waist of Pram-Tattva etc. The limbs of Karuna were cast down with many arrows and nearly one hundred arrows were discharged on the limbs of Shiksha.
10 Part 2.24: Then the warrior name Daan, taking the arrows of Gyan in his hand, performed worship and gave offerings, charming it with Dhyan, he discharged it on that Youngman.
10 Part 2.25: The warriors named Daan sprang up in the war-arena, who was the store of arms, weapons and garments Taking ten arrows, he discharged them on the waist-area of Lobh He seemed to be swimming in the seven oceans of Krodha. With nine arrows, he pierced the warrior named Anyaaya and the warriors named Avarai was pierced with three arrows With seven arrows, he wounded the warrior named karodh In this way Brahm-Gyan was patiently established. Several arrows discharged at Kalah, making him the target and with many arrows the warriors of Vair were killed Many arrows struck the limbs of Aalas and all these warriors fled towards hell. With one arrow the limb of Asheel was pierced and the second arrow was very nicely inflicted Kutisata The comely horses of Abhiman were killed and also destroyed the fighters of ANARTH etc. Pipasa, Kshudha, Aalas etc. ran away and knowing the enragement of Daviva, Lobh also ran away The destroyer of Aniyam, Niyam also became enraged and that detached one without greed assumed Yogastras. The head of Kapat was broken and he was killed and the dreadful warriors like Rosh, Moha, Kaam etc. were also killed in great fury, He shot and arrow on Karodh and in this way, the Lord in anger destroyed all the sufferings.
10 Part 2.26: Droha and Ahamkara were also killed with a thousand arrows No attention was paid, not even slightly, to Daridarta and Moha Ashoch and Kumantarna were destroyed with many arrows and Kalank was fearlessly pierced with thousand of arrows. Kritghanta, Vishwasghaat and Mittraghaat were also killed Brahmdosh and Raajdosh were finished with Bramastra Ucchatan, Maaran and Vashikarn etc. were killed with arrows Vishaad, though considered old one, ws not let off. The charioteer, horses and the masters of elephants ran away in fear Her great chariot-owners, forsaking their shame, fled away How should I describe this impossible and dreadful war as to how it was fought ? If the same is described hundreds or thousands of times, even then the end of its greatness cannot be known. Kalank, Vibharam and Kritghanta etc. were killed No attention was paid, even slightly to VISHAD, VIPDA etc. After killing Mittradosh, Raajdosh, Irsha etc. Ucchatan and Vishad were driven out of the battlefield. 321 Galani was pierced with many arrows Anarth was pierced with a thousand arrows with full power Kuchaal was attacked with thousand of fine arrows Kashat and Kutriya were caused to run away.
10 Part 2.27: Tapasya inflicted seventy arrows on Atap Sheel was inflicted with ninety arrows Jaap struck a thousand arrows to Ajap, Kumat was pierced with twenty arrows and Kukaram with thirty arrows Ten arrows were shot at Daridarta and Kaam was pierced with many arrows The warrior Avivek killed the warrior Virodh in the war-arena Sanjam said, while taking up sword in his hand and getting infuriated in the battlefield. Even if the sun rises in the West or the clouds begin to come from the North If the Meru mountain flies and all the water of the ocean is dried up Even if the teeth of KAL are bent and the hood of Sheshnaga is overturned Even if the Ganges flows contrarily and Harish Chandra may forsake the path of truth Even if the world is upturned and the earth stabilized on the back of the bull may burst while sinking, but O king Avivek, the heroic discipline of Vivek will not step back even then.
10 Part 2.28: I, a dumbed one, speak with your grace, I am a sacrifice to you and under your refuge.The great warrior Sanjam got infuriated he was proud and vice-less Taking up his innumerable arms, he attacked Anarth and pierced the limbs of Anadat.
10 Part 2.29: I SPEAK WITH YOUR POWER : There was such a war to what extent I should described it ? If I speak with thousand of tongues, even then I cannot know the end The war continued for the years of ten lakh ages and innumerable warriors died.
10 Part 2.30: I UTTER WITH YOUR POWER : There was blind and rash destruction in war The sixty-four Yoginis and the fiends danced The dreadful Kamakkhya like Kali danced and the Dakinis belched like flames.
10 Part 2.31: Thy Power There was terrible war and no one retraced his steps There were many great warriors and Sovereigns there This war continued in all the worlds and then warriors were not finished even in this dreadful war.
10 Part 2.32: Thy Power DOHRA In that fierce fight the great warriors were chopped quickly No warrior ran and retraced his steps and this war did not end.
10 Part 2.33: Thy Power CHAUPAI The war continued from both sides for twenty lakh ages, but no one was defeated Then the king got agitated and came to Matsyendra., “O superb sage! instruct me both of them are great warriors Their opposition does not end and with the desire to get release from them, the whole world is going to end. The whole world fought and fell on trying to kill them, but it could not know their end These dreadful warriors are greatly persistent, greatly heroic and greatly terrible. Hearing this Matsyendra remained silent and Parasnath etc. all of them said their things to him There then occurred a miracle, marvelous for all and on the same day Charpatnath appeared. Now begins the description of the Praise of Primal Purusha
10 Part 2.34: O king! listen, I speak to you a thing of knowledge You should not consider both as one these vice-less persons are great archers and brace fighters. When Primal Purusha, the Lord reflected within Himself and visualized his own form himself, He uttered the world AUMKARA, because of which the earth, the sky and the whole world was created. He created truth from the right side and Made falsehood on the left On taking birth both these warriors began to fight and Since that time, they are opposing each other in the world. If the span of life is increased by a thousand years, if the thousands of tongues are obtained and if the reflection is made for thousands of years, even then, O Lord! the limits of your cannot be known.
10 Part 2.35: The dumb speaks by Thy power : Many sages like Vyas, Prashar, Shringi etc. have mentioned it A Brahma of thousands of faces has been seen, but all of them could not know Thy limits.
10 Part 2.36: Thy Power DOHRA The mighty ocean, many heroes, sages, Gandharvas, Mahants etc. have been feeling agitated since crores of alpas, but all of them could not know Thy limits.
10 Part 2.37: I speak by Thy Power :O lion-like king! whatever I am saying to you, listen to it attentively and do not oppose it That Primal Purusha Lord, is without beginning, unconquerable, without secret, uncombustible and without form. He is without name and place He is indestructible, Without beginning, unconquerable, fearless and without hatred He is infinite master of the universe and the most Ancient One He is present, future and past. He has conquered in this world all the Yogis, the hermits with matted locks, performers of Yajnas, the water-dwellers and Nishachars etc He has subjugated the celibates, Yogis warriors, wearers of fire-flames around their necks, the mighty ones and the sovereigns of mountains.
10 Part 2.38: Thy Power Consider all Yantras and Mantras as false and consider all those religions as hollow, Which are deluded by the learning of Tantras Without having hopes on that one Lord, you will be disappointed from all other sides Without the one Name of the Lord, nothing else will be of any use. If the powers are realized through Mantras and Yantras, then no one will wander from door to door Remove your attention from all other sides, assuming only one hope in the mind and without the one action of the meditation on the Lord, consider all else as illusion. When the king heard these words of the Yogi, he became fearful in his mind like the oscillation of water He forsook all the hopes and despairs from his mind and uttered these words to that great Yogi.
10 Part 2.39: O great sage! you have been bestowed with all the powers I request you to guide me. The warriors of both the sides, persistent and enraged, Ever remembering the Lord and destroyers of others uptil ocean They are the ones who resist, who fight persistently, Who are severe and cruel and are the smashers of the enemies.
10 Part 2.40: Thy Power CHAUPAI If I cannot conquer them, I Shall burn myself on the funeral pure O sage! I could not conquer them My strength and courage have weakened. Thinking in this way in his mind, the king apparently addressed all, “I am a very great king and I have conquered the whole world. “He who has told me to conquer both these warriors VIVEK and AVIVEK, He has agitated me and driven my life to deception Both of them are mighty warriors The whole world is conquered, on conquering them. “Now they will not go away from me, O sage! describe them to me with clarity “Now I prepare my own funeral pyre within your view, and sit within the fire-flames.” After preparing the funeral pyre, he took bath and wore the garments of deep orange colour on his body Many people forbade him and even fell at his feet. Giving in charity various types of ornaments and garments, the king prepared a seat within the pyre He burnt his body with various kinds of fires, but the flames became cold instead of burning him.
10 Part 2.41: Getting infuriated, Parasnath burnt the fire in his hand, which was dreadful in sight, but became cold there. Then he got emerged the Yoga-fire, which was burning dreadfully He killed himself with that fire and the people of the city continued to see that great king. Then with many grass-blades, the faggots alongwith ghee, The flames of fire arose, in which the king was burnt and his body was reduced to ashes. That pyre continued to burn for several years, when the body of the king was reduced to ashes And he abandoned the attachment of wealth and place.

14 Part 1.1: The Lord is One and the Victory is of the True Guru. Shastra-Nama Mala Purana is now composed With the support of the primal power by the Tenth King. DOHRA O Lord! Protect us by creating Saang, Sarohi, Saif, As, Teer tupak, Talwaar and other weapons and armours causing the destruction of the enemies. O Lord! Creat As, Kripan, Dharaddhari, Sail, Soof, Jamaadh, Tegh, Teer, Teer, Talwar, causing the destruction of armours and enemies. As, Kripan, Khanda, Khadag, Tupak, Tabar, Teer, Saif, Sarohi and Saihathi, all these are our adorable seniors. Thou are the Teer, Thou are Saihathi, Thou art Tabar, and Talwaar He, who remembers Thy Name crosses the dreadful ocean of existence. Thou art the KAL, thou art the goddess Kali, Thou art the saber and arrow, Thou art the sign of victory today and Thou art the Hero of the world. Thou art the Sool, Saihathi and Tabar, Thou art the Nikhang and Baan, Thou art the Kataari, Sel, and all and Thou art the Kard, and Kripaan. Thou art the arms and weapons, Thou art the Nikhang, and the Kavach Thou art the destroyer of the armours and Thou art also all pervading. Thou art the cause of peace and prosperity and the essence of learning Thou art the creator of all and the redeemer of all. Thou art the day and night and Thou art the creator of all the Jivas, causing disputes among them Thou does all this in order to view Thy own sport. O Lord! Protect us by smashing the armour with the blows of Thy hands with the help of As, Kripaan, Khanda, Kharag, Saif, Tegh, and Talwaar. Thou art Kataari, Jamdaadh, Bichhuaa and Baan, O power! I am a serf of Thy Lord’s feet, kindly Protect me. Thou art Baank, bajar, Bichhuaa, Tabar, and Talwaar, Thou art the kataari, and Saihathi Protect me. Thou art Gurj, Gadaa, Teer and Tufang Protect me ever considering me as Thy slave. Thou art the Chhurri, the enemy-killing karad and the Khanjar are Thy names Thou art the adorable Power of the world, kindly protect me. Firstly Thou createst the world, and then the Paths Then Thou crreatest the disputes and also help them. Thou art Machh, Kachh and Varaha Thou art also the Dwarf incarnation Thou art also narsingh and Buddha and Thou art the Essence of the whole world. Thou art Rama, Krishna and Vishnu Thou art the subjects of the whole world and Thou art also the Sovereign. Thou art the Brahmin, Kshatriya, the king and the poor Thou art also Sama, Sama, Dand and Bhed and also other remedies. Thou art the head, trunk and the life-force of all the creatures The whole world imbibes all the learning from Thee and elucidates the Vedas. Thou art the significant arrow fitted in the bow and Thou art also called the warrior Kaibar O Thou called by various names of the arrows! You may also do my job. Thy house is the quiver and Thou killest like deer the enemies by becoming the shaft-power Thy reality is that Thou killest the enemies beforehand and the sword strikes later on. Thou art the axe which tears away the enemies and also Thou art the noose, which binds down Thou art Supremely Enduring One also on whomsoever Thou didst bestow the boon, Thou didst make him the king of the world. Thou art the sword and dagger chopping the enemies and considering Indra as Thy devotee Thou didst bestow on him the position of the king of gods. Yamdhaar and Yamdadh and all other names of the weapons fro the destruction of the warriors, Thou hast folded up and bound all their power in Thyself. Baank, Bajar, Bichhuaa and the shafts of love, on whomsoever Thou didst shower Thy Grace, They all became the Sovereigns of the world. The lion is Thy weapons like the sword in the war, which destroys the enemies He, on whom, Thou didst shower Thy Grace, he was redeemed from th noose of Yama. Thou art the Saif and Sarohi and Thy Name is the destroyer of the enemies You abide in our heart and fulfil our tasks. End of the first chapter entitled “The Praise of the Primal Power” in Shri Nam-Mala Purana.
14 Part 1.2: The Description of the Names of Discus DOHRA Putting the word “Kavach” in the beginning and adding the word Ar-deha at the end, The wise people know all the other names of Kripaan. The word “Shatru” is uttered in the beginning and the word “Dusht” is spoken at the end and In this way all the names of Jagnnath are adopted in the heart. Saying the word “Prithvi” in the beginning and then uttering the word “Paalak” all the Names of the Lord are stuffed in the mind. Uttering the word “Sarishti” in the beginning and then the word “Nath”, All the Names of the Lord are adopted in the heart. Uttering the word “Sarishti” in the beginning and then the word “Vahan”, The poets may in this way say all the Names of Durga, the mother of the world. That Lord is the destroyer of he enemies, Creator of the world and also the Vanquisher of the foolish people in this world. His Name should be remembered, by hearing which all the suffering come to an end. 15 Part 1.1: The Lord is One and the Victory is of the True Guru. Tenth Master, Deviant Metre, the Grace of God You are the Broad Sword with decapitating edge. You are Arrow, Dagger, Halb, South, and West. I can envision you to the limits of my perception. You are the capable deity - Sarswati, Roopa and Bhawani. You are the divinity - Vishnu, Brahma and Shiva, and, Majestically, You are established in motherly form. You have created Deities, Demons Prayer-worthies, Turks and Hindus. Descending in various Forms, You have produced the altercating folks. You have rueful looks as well as you adore beautiful eyes. You are pretty, and, also, you possess contorted features. You enunciate the Four Vedas, But don’t hesitate to decimate the Demons. With you the dread of war increases. The great rulers pray to you and, with the swords and arrows, Annihilate the armies. Guising as Narsing, the Sphinx, you smashed Harnakash. And incarnating as Varah in the form of a boar, You bore the weight of the earth. Manifesting as Rama, you exterminated the stubborn Devil. And turning into Krishana terminated Kans, the semi-bestial. You are known as Jalpa, Kalka And are the Rani of the fourteen continent. You are roaming around during the nights of death. You are the initiator of the Universe, and you destroy the Universe. You are narrated by the rulers of the rulers, As you are the Rani of Fourteen continents. People called you as the kindest of kinds, And you are known through the sacred hymns of Vyas Rishi. You formulate the lion’s retreat, And you are recognized as the lion, as well. The cutting dagger suits your hands, And you have obliterated the demons of Chund and Mund. You invaded the enemies called Rakat Beej, And you protected the divinity, as well. In rage you terminated the demons of Mehkhasur, And burned to death Dhumarach and Javalach. With impregnable and protective mantras You finished Bidalach and Chichrachas. You beat the drum of invasion and, Then, jovially, penetrated the warfare. Holding eight weapons in your eight arms, you won over the invincible brave-enemies, And holding them from their hair knocked them down. You are Jayanti, Mangal, Kali, Kapali You are , Bhadarkali, Durga, And epitome of benevolence and emancipation. You are universal protector, and I pay my obeisance to you. Adoring red apparels, it is you, and in white clothes you are Usha And Sandhiya, wherefore capturing all the minds. You, yourself, put on yellow garments, but You dislodge the ascetics of their infatuation. You, with the red teeth, Destroy the apprehension of the Brahmins. You incarnated in the house of Nand, Because you were brimful with Faculty. You, incarnating as Nihaqlanki, Shattered the outcastes. O my matriarch, endow me with your benevolence, And let me perform the way I elect.

15 Part 15.33: She revelled in making love, adopting different postures. Kissing and cuddling, she satiated herself but her husband kept lying quietly.
15 Part 15.34: Then he cried and said, ‘Oh, Peer, what have you done to me?’ The Peer responded, ‘You are tasting the fruit of your own action.’ -
15 Part 15.35: ‘Please forgive me for my sins. ‘I was misled. Please pardon me. ‘Abandoning you, I will never go anyone else. ‘Oh, my Peer, for years to come, I will remain obedient to you.’
15 Part 15.36: When the paramour was gratified with sex, the Raja was let loose. She bade goodbye to the friend and then asked Raja to get up. The imprudent did not discern and thought that the Peer had toppled him over. After being untied, he cleaned the place but he could not acquiesce the wife’s deviousness. 139th Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed With Benediction.
15 Part 15.37: Baani Raae was the Raja of the pier of Hijlee. Megh Mati was his pretty wife. The lady saw Majlis Raae and fell in love with him. She invited him and, God willing, had sex with him.
15 Part 15.38: When Baani Raae heard that a paramour had come to his house, He decided to tie his both the legs and throw him in the stream. When Rani learnt aboUt his determination, she got a rope, She tied him and asked him to jump over the wall.
15 Part 15.39: By tying him with the rope she helped the friend to escape, And the stupid Raja did not perceive the truth. 140th Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed With Benediction.
15 Part 15.40: In the city ofBhim Puree, a devil named Bhasmangad used to live, In fighting, there was none comparable to him.
15 Part 15.41: He meditated for a long time and attained a boon from Shiva. Any body, on whose head he placed his hand, he would be reduced to ashes. When he saw Paarbati, he thought to himself, ‘I will put my hand on the head of Shiva and perish him in the twinkling of eye.’ With this in mind he came to kill Shiva. When Shiva saw him, he, along with his wife, ran away. Seeing Shiva running away, the devils gave him a chase. Shiva headed towards east and the devil followed too.
15 Part 15.42: He kept roaming in three directions, but found no place to rest. Then, relying on the will of God, he ran towards North.
15 Part 15.43: When Shiva headed for North, Bhasmangad followed too, thinking, ‘I will reduce him to ashes and take Paarbati away.’
15 Part 15.44: Paarbati Talk Dohira ‘You fool, what boon have you been endowed with? ‘It is all a lie, you can test it.
15 Part 15.45: ‘Initially try to put your hand on your head, if a couple of hair are burnt, ‘Then you put your hand on the head of Shiva and win me over.’ When the devil heard this through his ears, he put his hand on his head. In a flicker, the idiot was burnt and the Shiva’s distress was eliminated.
15 Part 15.46: Through such an Chritar, Paarbati annihilated the devil, And taking Shiva with her, she went back and ensconced in the mountains of Kailasha. 141st Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed With Benediction.
15 Part 15.47: Bana Soor was the Raja of the city of Bushehar, And the rulers of all the other countries, revered him as Almighty, and bowed to him.
15 Part 15.48: His principal Rani followed the theology of yoga; she was exceptionally beautiful. Her youthfulness was very much savoured by all; the gods, the devils, Jachh and Bhujangs.
15 Part 15.49: She gave birth to a girl named Ukha, Who was serene and was endowed with charm.
15 Part 15.50: She was bestowed with pleasant features. The devils, the gods, Jachh, and Bhujang, all felt modest before her. If some one saw her with his own eyes, He would feel sold to her without any monetary gain. Her black eyes were epitome of the eyes of the deer, And they looked more attractive with eye-lasher in them. The Lotus-flower and the shine of the lightning looked humble before her. The pied wagtails had become mad on seeing her. The deer kept on roaming around in the jungle for her sight. The ascetics turned into celibates, for not getting her to yield. The birds were always looking for her.
15 Part 15.51: Sehas Bahu was her father, And thousands of arms and weapons were under his command. Annihilating many heroes, he had subdued many kings. He had been benevolent to Brahmin priests and gave out many cows in charity.
15 Part 15.52: The Rajas of all the regions paid him taxes. He was the devotee of Shiva. He asked for a boon from Shiva, which could win him a big war.
15 Part 15.53: Shiva Talk Dohira ‘When flag falls down on ground in your house, ‘Then you take it that a fearful war is going to break,’
15 Part 15.54: His sleeping daughter had such dream, which made her feel that the Cupid had come down, And by Ignoring the Cupid she had attained his son, who had been living in Dwarka.
15 Part 15.55: Dreaming about her infatuation with her lover, she abruptly got up. With dream of love she sweated and all the parts of her body ached.
15 Part 15.56: Shouting, ‘My love, my love,’ she fell down and became unconscious. Then her friends lifted her and Rekha Chi tar listened to all her story.
15 Part 15.57: Savaiyya ‘She is brimming with love and the secret in her, which she cannot describe. ‘She has got love-fever and detests the adornments. ‘She told me to go away as she could not describe her condition. ‘Either she is suffering due to lover’s separation, or some thing else. ‘I cannot say whether she will live or die. ‘She speaks like captivated person. ‘It appears she has taken poison or is under a saw in Kanshi over her head. ‘I think she will leave her home and become a nun. ‘Come and have a vision of your beloved otherwise Ukha Kala will die and you will be afflicted too.’
15 Part 15.58: Chitar Rekha, after listening, became very concerned. She flew like the wind and reached there.
15 Part 15.59: When she reached there, looking at her condition she fell flat. ‘I must strive to make her meet her lover, ‘By bringing in the person she had seen in the dream.’
15 Part 15.60: Then Chitar Kala built a castle and all round she drew the fourteen regions. She sketched the devils, the gods and Gandharabh Jachh.
15 Part 15.61: She carved there all the rulers ofthe world including, Balbhadar, and Anuradh and Krishna, the sons ofParduman. After creating there, fourteen fairies, she suggested her, ‘I have devised the means for your survival, come and see yourself.’
15 Part 15.63: After looking at fourteen fairies she reached there, Where all the members of Jadav family, including Krishna, were sitting. First she saw Balbhadar and then Krishna. She was appeased and, believing them to be the gurus of the world, bent and paid her obeisance.
15 Part 15.64: Then she saw Parduman and, modestly, bent her head in reverence. But when she saw his son, Anuradh, she felt all her affliction eradicated.
15 Part 15.65: With praises, she thanked her friend. ‘What I saw in dream, I perceived it vividly. ‘Taking me through fourteen regions, you have shown me every thing. ‘Now you must make me to meet him in reallife.’
15 Part 15.66: Acquiescing to her requests, she manifested herself as air, And felt relieved reaching Dwarakpuree.
15 Part 15.67: Chitar Kala communicated to the prince, Anuradh, ‘The damsel from high up mountains, spell bound by your eyes, has come to see you. ‘Yearning to meet you, she has become desperate.’
15 Part 15.68: ‘My love, you come with me to the region, wherever I tell you go, ‘Come flying on a bibaan and make my place pious.’
15 Part 15.69: Harkening to the plea, Anuradh agreed to accompany, And commenced journey to the city of Bushehar.
15 Part 15.70: ‘If you command, I will become your slave and fetch pitcher of water for you. ‘If you command, I can sell myself for money in the bazaar. ‘If you like, you may hand me over to some body in the alms. ‘Because, due to your endeavour, I have gained my lover. ‘My friend, through your benevolence, I have achieved my sweetheart. ‘Through your kindness, I have shed all my distress. ‘Through your generosity, I will enjoy profound lovemaking. ‘And in all the fourteen regions, I have acquired an handsome mate.’
15 Part 15.71: Then she called the mate, And gratified herself by making-love adopting many positions.
15 Part 15.72: Emoploying eighty-four poses, she kissed him variably. Whole night she spent love-making and Ukha realized only when it dawned. She kept the friend whole night in her house but Bana Soor Raja had no knowledge. In the meantime the flag fell and the Raja became very apprehensive.
15 Part 15.73: He gathered all the fighters along with their weapons. Remembering Shiva’s prophesy, they were mobilised there.
15 Part 15.74: Whereas the Raja was busy in mustering army, they were, together, revelling in sex. Employing eighty-four position they were rejoicing sexually. When the Raja saw the girl frolicking in lovemaking, He planned to beat them up and send them to the domain of death.
15 Part 15.75: On seeing, her father has arrived, she put her eyes down in shame. And said, ‘Please think of some remedy to save our honour.’ Anuradh got up and took his bow and arrows in his hand. He cut off many imperishable brave fighter.
15 Part 15.76: Speech of the poet. Chaupai Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands all the desires of my heart be fulfilled. Let my mind rest under Thy Feet Sustain me, considering me Thine own. Destroy, O Lord! all my enemies and protect me with Thine won Hnads. May my family live in comfort and ease alongwith all my servants and disciples. Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands and destroy this day all my enemies May all the aspirations be fulfilled Let my thirst for Thy Name remain afresh. I may remember none else except Thee And obtain all the required boons from Thee Let my servants and disciples cross the world-ocean All my enemies be singled out and killed. Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands and relieve me form the fear of death May Thou ever Bestow Thy favours on my side Protect me O Lord! Thou, the Supreme Destroyer. Protect me, O Protector Lord! Most dear, the Protector of the Saints: Friend of poor and the Destroyer of the enemies Thou art the Master of the fourteen worlds. In due time Brahma appeared in physical form In due time Shiva incarnated In due time Vishnu manifested himself All this is the play of the Temporal Lord. The Temporal Lord, who created Shiva, the Yogi Who created Brahma, the Master of the Vedas The Temporal Lord who fashioned the entire world I salute the same Lord. The Temporal Lord, who created the whole world Who created gods, demons and yakshas He is the only one form the beginning to the end I consider Him only my Guru. I salute Him, non else, but Him Who has created Himself and His subject He bestows Divine virtues and happiness on His servants He destroys the enemies instantly. He knows the inner feelings of every heart He knows the anguish of both good and bad From the ant to the solid elephant He casts His Graceful glance on all and feels pleased. He is painful, when He sees His saints in grief He is happy, when His saints are happy. He knows the agony of everyone He knows the innermost secrets of every heart. When the Creator projected Himself, His creation manifested itself in innumerable forms When at any time He withdraws His creation, all the physical forms are merged in Him. All the bodies of living beings created in the world speak about Him according to their understanding But Thou, O Lord! live quite apart from everything this fact is know to the Vedas and the learned. The Lord is Formless, Sinless and shelterless: He is the Primal Power, without Blemish, without Beginning and Unborn The fool claims boastfully about the knowledge of His secrets, which even the Vedas do not know. The fool considers Him a stone, but the great fool does not know any secret He calls Shiva “The Eternal Lord, “but he does not know the secret of the Formless Lord. According to ones won intellect, one describes Thee differently The limits of Thy creation cannot be known and how the world was fashioned in the beginning? He hath only one unparalleled Form He manifests Himself as a poor man or a king at different places He created creatures from eggs, wombs and perspiration Then He created the vegetable kingdom. Somewhere He sits joyfully as a king Somewhere He contracts Himself as Shiva, the Yogi All His creation unfolds wonderful things He, the Primal Power, is from the beginning and Self-Existent. O Lord! keep me now under Thy protection Protect my disciples and destroy my enemies All the villains creations outrage and all the infidels be destroyed in the battlefield. O Supreme Destroyer! those who sought Thy refuge, their enemies met painful death The persons who fell at Thy Feet, Thou didst remove all their troubles. Those who meditate even on the Supreme Destroyer, the death cannot approach them They remain protected at all times Their enemies and troubles come to and end instantly. Upon whomsoever Thou dost cast Thy favourable glance, they are absolved of sins instantly They have all the worldly and spiritual pleasures in their homes None of th enemies can even touch their shadow. He, who remembered Thee even once, Thou didst protect him from the noose of death Those persons, who repeated Thy Name, they were saved from poverty and attacks of enemies. Bestow thy help own me at all places protect me from the design of my enemies. Bestow Thy help on me at all places and protect me from the designs of my enemies. The Mother of the world has been kind towards me and I have completed the book this auspicious night The Lord is the destroyer of all the sins of the body and all the malicious and wicked persons. When Mahakal became kind, He immediately caused me to complete this book He will obtain the fruit desired by the mind and no suffering will occur to him.
15 Part 15.77: The dumb, who will listen to it, will be blessed with the tongue to speak The fool, who will listen to it attentively, will get wisdom That person will be absolved of suffering, pain or fear, Who will even once recite this Chaupai-prayer.
15 Part 15.78: It was Bikrami Samvat 1753 This book was competed on the banks of Sutlej on Sunday, the eighth Sudi of the month of Bhadon.
